Gurdey Kya Kam Karte Hai – How Kidney Function
Sharir mein khoon saaf karna, naya khoon banana, blood pressure, blood cells, paani aur calcium ka balance banaye rakhna kidney ka kaam hota hai. Kidney blood ko purify karke isme maujood vishale padartho ko peshab ke raste shareer se bahar nikalti hai. Body mein laal rakt koshikao ko banane wale harmons ko sahi rakhna bhi gurdo ka ek mukhay kaam hai.
Kidney ki Bimariya Hone ke Karan – Causes of Kidney Damage
- Kam paani pina
- Cold drinks pina
- Peshab rokana
- Puri neend na lena
- Jada namak khana
- Smoking karna aur sharab pina.
- Khane mein vitamin aur minerals ki kami hona.
Jin logo ko sugar, high blood pressure hota hai aur jinke parviar mein kabhi kisi ka kidney failure ya kidney se judi koi bimari hui ho unme kidney kharab hone ki sambhavna dusro se jada hoti hai.
Kidney Kharab Hone ke Lakshan – Symptoms
Kidney ke rog ko pehchanane ka sabse bada lakshan hai peshab(urine) karte samay dard hona ya peshab mein blood aana. Iske ilava kuch aur symptoms bhi hai.
- Thand lagna.
- Bhukh kam lagna.
- Sharir mein sujan aana.
- Sharer mein thakan aur kamjori aana.
- Peshab mein protein ki maatra adhik hona.
- Peshab mein jalan hona aur bar bar aana.
- Blood pressure ka badha rehna.
- Skin par rashes niklana aur khujli hona.
- Munh ka sawad kharab hona aur muh se badboo aana.
Kidney Function Test
Kidney ke test se blood mein maujood creatinine aur ureia ki matra ka pta lagaya jata hai, isse kidney ki work capacity ke bare mein jankari milti hai. Agar kisi bimari ke karan gurdo ko thoda bahut nuksan ho jaye to test mein kuch nahi dikhta par jab dono gurde 50% se jada kharab ho jaye tab khoon mein creatinine aur urea ki matra adhik ho jati hai.
Kidney Failure in Hindi
Agar body mein 1 gurda kharab ho gaya ho aur operation karke use shareer se nikal diya jaye tab dusra gurda apni work capacity badhate hue apna kaam puri tarah karta hai. Kidney failure tab hota hai jab dono gurde kaam karna band kar de. Kidney failure 2 tarah ki hoti hai – acute aur chronic.
1. Acute Kidney Failure: Isme kisi bimari ke karan jab dono gurdo ko nuksan pahunchta hai tab kuch samay ke baad hi gurde kaam karna kam ya band kaar dete hai. Agar is bimari ka upchar turant kiya jaye to kuch samay mein hi ise thik kiya ja sakta hai. Acute kidney failure mein patients ka ilaaj medicines aur parhej se kiya jata hai aur kabhi kabhi kuch marijo ko kuch dino ke liye dialysis bhi karwani padti hai.
2. Chronic Kidney Failure: Isme kai parkar ki bimariyo ke karan dono gurde dhere dhere kaam karna band kar dete hai. Shuruaat mein medicine aur parhej se kidney ki working capacity badhane ki koshish ki jati hai par agar samasya control na ho aur gambhir ban jaye tab dialysis aur kidney transplant ka sahara liya jata hai.
Nephrotic Syndrome Kya Hai
Ye kidni ki ek bimari hai. Peshaab (urine) mein protein ka aana, cholesterol badhna, blood mein protein ki kami hona aur sharir mein sujan aana iske lakshan hai. Vese to ye bimari kisi bhi umar ke vyakti ko ho sakti hai par bacho mein iske lakshan adhik dekhne ko milte hai. Ek bar treatment karne ke baad sujan kam hona aur fir kuch samay baad sujan fir se dikhne lagna hi nephrotic syndrome ke symptoms hai.
Kidney Transplant ke Khatre – Side Effects
- Kidney transplant ke baad thoda bahut infection hona normal hai.
- Kuch cases mein kidney transplant karwane ke bad blood cloting ki problem hone lagti hai.
- Kidney pratyaropan ke baad sardi jukham hona aam hai.
Kidney ka ilaj – Allopathy Treatment Tips in Hindi
- Kidney ki bimari badhne par iske ilaaj ke liye dialysis aur transplant jese treatment hote hai. Vese to hum 1 kidney ke sahare bhi jinda reh sakte hai lekin dono gurde kharab hone par transplant hi karwana padta hai.
- Dialysis mein kidney ko swasth rakhne ke liye machine ke dawara khoon saaf kiya jata hai aur transplant mein sharir mein naye gurde dale jate hai.
- Sarkari hospitals mein transplant karwane ke liye saalo intejaar karna padta hai lekin private hospitals mein turant operation karke kidney transplant kar dete hai lekin waha iska ilaaj kafi mehnga hota hai.
Kidney ka ilaj Ayurveda Nuskhe se Kaise Kare
1. Ayurvedic guno se bharpur ek podha hai jiska naam hai Kasani. Is podhe ki pattiyo ka sevan kidney, sugar, liver aur bawasir jesi bimariyo ke upchar mein ramban ka kam karti hai. Ye herbal podha aapko apne aas pass kisi nursery mein mil jayega. Kidney ke rogo ka desi ilaj karne ke liye aapko har roj kasani podhe ki pattiya tod kar chabani hai. Is podhe ka vansapati naam Cichorium intybus hai.
2. Teen gilass paani mein 10 graam pipal ki chaal aur 10 graam neem ki chaal le kar ubaal le aur jab paani aadha reh jaye tab ise thanda hone ke liye chod de aur baad mein chaan le. Ab is paani ka ek chajthayi hissa din mein 3 se 4 baar piye. Is desi nuskhe ko ek hafta lagatar karne se createnine control mein aa jati hai.
3. 250 graam Gokharu Kanta le kar ise 4 litre paani mein ubaal le aur jab paani 1 litre reh jaye tab ise chaan kar kisi saaf bottle ya jug mein bhar le. Ab 100 graam ki matra mein ye kadha subh shaam khali pet piye. Kadha pine ke baad 1 ghante tak kuch khaye piye nahi. Agar aap ki koi medicine chal rhi hai to use bhi chalne de. Agar aapka dialysis chal rha hai ya fir doctor ne aapko kidney transplant ki salah di hai to transplant se pahle ek baar ye upay jarur kare. Ye ayurvedic nuskha kaafi kargar hai aur ho sakta hai transplant ki jarurat hi na pade. Gokharu Kanta aapko pansari ki shop se mil jayega. 2 hafte lagatar is upay ko karne se aapko chamatkari badlaav dekhne ko milenge.
Gurde ki Bimariyo ke Gharelu Upay – Natural Home Remedies for Kidney Diseases in Hindi
1. Vitamin
Vese to vitamin puri body ke liye faydemand hai par kuch khaas tarah ke vitamin gurdo ko healthy rakhne mein madad karte hai, jese vitamin D. Iske sevan se kidney ki bimariyo ke lakshano ko kam kiya ja sakta hai. Vitamin B6 kidney mein pathri ki aashanka ko kam karta hai aur vitamin C ke sevan se kidney ko kisi bhi parkar ke nuksan se bachaya ja sakta hai.
2. Apple Cider Vinegar
Is mein maujood antibacterial tatav kidney ko bacteria infection se bachate hai. Agar kidney mein pathri(stone) ho to apple cider vinegar ke istemal se pathri dhere dhere apne aap khatam ho jata hai. Iske ilava apple cider kidney se hanikarak tatv bahar nikalta hai jisse gurde swasth rehte hai.
3. Baking Soda
Ek research mein british researchers ne ye pta lagaya ki sodium bicarbonate kidney ke rogo se bachne ke liye kafi faydemand hota hai. Iski madad se blood mein hone wali acidity khatam ho jati hai jo gurde ke rogo ka karan hoti hai.
4. Vegetables Juice
Kidney se judi koi bimari hone par lauki, kheera, gajar aur patta gobhi ka ras piye, isse gurde ke rogo ka ilaj karne mein madad milti hai. iske ilava aaloo aur tarbuj ka ras bhi kidney ki samasyao ko thik karne ke liye acha hai. Jaldi aaram ke liye inka sevan din mein 2 bar kare.
5. Munakka ka Paani
Rojana raat ko sone se pahle kuch daane munakka paani mein bhigo kar rakhe aur subh is paani mein se munakka nikal kar sirf paani piye. Kuch din lagatar is upay ko karne se kidney ke rogo ka upchar jaldi ho jata hai.
6. Paani Jaada Piye
Gurdo ko swasth rakhne ke liye jaruri hai ki isme maujood hanikarak padarth bahar nikal diye jaye, uske liye jaruri hai aap paani ki maatra jada le. Paani mein nimbu nichod kar bhi le sakte hai isse vitamin C ki bhi purti hogi.
Rajiv Dixit ke Upay Hindi Mein
Khana khane ke turant baad peshab (urine) karne ki aadat banaye. Is niyam ko niranatar apnane se gurdey ki bahut si bimariyo se door reh sakte hai. Jo log kidney infection ya kidney ke kisi aur rog se pidit hai unke liye ye bahut faydemand upay hai. Gurde ki bimariyo se bachane ke sath sath ye liver, gathiya, kamar ke rog aur prostate ke badhne jesi samasyao se bhi bachata hai.
Baba Ramdev Yoga aur Excersise Kare
Agar aap kidni ki bimari se pareshan hai to exercises aur yoga karna shuru kare. Agar hafte mein 3 se 4 din bhi exercises ki to aapki kidney mein sudhar aa sakta hai. Kidney ka ilaj karne ke liye aap baba ramdev ke bataye hue pranayam aur yogasan kar sakte hai.
Kidney ki Bimariyo se Kaise Bache (Parhej)
- Agar aapko kidney ke rogo se bachna hai to jaruri hai ki aap kisi bhi parkar ke infection se bache rahe.
- Healthy diet le aur fast food na khaye.
- Jada tanav na le aur din ki shuruaat exercises aur yoga se kare.
- Agar paani saaf na ho to ise ubaal kar piye.
- Bazzar mein milne wale dabba band khane se parhej kare.
- Body ka weight jada badhne na de.
- Agar ulti, dast ya bukhar hua hai to sharer mein paani ki kami na hone de. Isliye paani ki pryaprt matra le.
- Smoking, sharab ya koi dusra nasha na kare, isse blood circulation slow ho jata hai.
- Pain killer dawayio ka upyog kam se kam kare, kyuki ye dawaye kidni ko nuksan pahunchati hai.
- Thand aur dhul mitti se bhi infection ho sakta hai isliye bahar jate samay muh aur naak dhak kar rakhe isse bacteria aur thandi hawa aap ko bimar nahi kar payegi.
- Namak ka sevan kam kare.
- Aese sports na khele jisme kidney mein chot lagne ki aashanka ho.
- Saal mein ek bar doctor se body checkup jarur karwaye.
- Agar aapke shareer mein ek hi kidni hai to kisi bhi parkar ki bimari ke treatment ya operation se pahle doctor ko is bare mein jarur bataye.
- Healthy lifestyle ko apna kar hum gurde ki bimariyo se bache reh sakte hai.
Kehte hai ilaaj se behtar hai bachav, isliye aapse yahi salah hai ki kidney ke rogo se bachne ke upay karte rahe taki aap dialysis aur trasplant jesi cheejo se door reh sako. Kidney ka ilaj natural ayurveda nuskhe se kaise kare, kidney infection treatment in hindi ka ye lekh aap ko kaisa laga hame comment karke bataye aur agar aapke pass gurde ki bimariyo ke desi nuskhe hai to hamare sath bhi share kare.

Washington: Ameriki raashtrapati Barack Obama ne yuddh prabhaavit Afghanistan se agale saal 34 hajaar ameriki sainikon ko hata lene ki ghoshana ki. Saath hi Obama ne vishvaas jataaya ki ek dashak lambi chali is ladaai ka ant varsh 2014 ke ant tak ho jaaega. Obama ne kaha, is vasant hamaare bal sahaayak ki bhoomika mein aa jaaenge, jabki Afghan suraksha bal mukhya morcha sambhaalenge. Aaj main yeh ghoshana kar sakta hoon ki agale saal anya 34 hajaar ameriki sainik Afghanistan se lautakar apne ghar aa jaaenge. Unhonne kaha, sainik hataane ki yeh prakriya jaari rahegi. Agale saal ke ant tak Afghanistan mein hamaari ladaai ka ant ho jaaega. Obama ne kaha ki 2014 ke baad bhi ekeekrut aur samprabhu Afghanistan ke prati America ki pratibaddhata to jaari rahegi, lekin is pratibaddhata ki prakruti jaroor badal jaaegi. Unhonne kaha, ham Afghanistan sarkaar ke saath do abhiyaanon par aadhaarit ek samjhaute par baatcheet kar rahe hain. In do abhiyaanon mein se ek hai-Afghan balon ka prashikshan aur unhein samarth banaana taaki yeh desh dobaara kisi avyavastha mein na fanse. Doosra abhiyaan hai, aatankvaad rodhi prayaas. Iske tahat ham Al Qaeda aur uske samarthit anya sangathanon ke avasheshon ki khoj kar sakte hain. Sainikon aur naagrikon ko salaam karte hue Obama ne kaha, aap logon ki vajah se ham vishvaas ke saath kah sakte hain ki America Afghanistan mein apna abhiyaan poora kar lega aur Al Qaeda ko haraane ka lakshya haasil kar lega. Unhonne kaha ki ham pehle apne 33 hajaar bahaadur sevaakarmiyon ko ghar vaapas la chuke hain. Is faisale ka svaagat karte hue raksha mantri Leon peneta ne kaha ki yeh faisala pradarshit karta hai ki America Afghanistan mein safalta haasil karne ke sahi raaste par hai. Unhonne kaha ki kramabaddh tareeke se agale saal tak Afghanistan se ameriki balon ko hataane ki sifaarish general John Allen ne ki thi. Afghanistan mein America aur naato ke is poorv commander ki ye sifaarishein aaiesaeef (antararaashtreeya suraksha sahayog bal) ke abhiyaan ko aage badhaane ki yojana ke poore aakalan par aadhaarit thi. Unhonne kaha, mera maanana hai ki raashtrapati ka yeh faisala hamein Afghanistan mein safalta haasil karne ke sahi raaste par le jaata hai.

Dosto Haldi jise hum Termaric ke naam se bhi jante hai. Iske bahut se fayde hai aur aap sabhi jante hai ki haldi ka istemal sabhi gharo me kiya jata hai ab chahe khana banane me ho ya ayurvedic upchar. Haldi humare sarir ke liye har tarah se faydemabd hi hota hai. waise Haldi hume market me asaani se mil bhi jata hai aur iski kheti bhi India me hoti hai. Jo sabhi ko asaani se mil jati hai. Haldi ko sabhi bimari ko thik karne ka ek achha sadhan mana jata hai aur kaha bhi jata hai ki har bimari ki ek dawa haldi hai.
Haldi me paye jane wale poshak tatwa humare sarir ko jaruri tatwo ki purti karate hai isme anti oxidant ki maojudagi se humare sehat ka bahut dhyan dete hai. Haldi ka istemal pooja path me bhi kiya jata hai haldi ka ek vishesh jagah mana jata hai. Aur haldi bahut sudhh mani jati hai. Iske sevan se bahut si bimari dur hoti hai aur isme paye jane wale tatwa sabhi tarah ki bimari ko dur karte hai. Aaj iss article me hum janege ki haldi khane ke kya kya fayde hai aur iska istemal kaise kiya jaye jisse fayda doguna ho. Aiye jante hai.
Haldi khane ke fayde –
- Pachan sakti badhaye – Dosto haldi ke sevan se humara pachan tantra majboot hota hai sath hi hum jo bhi khate hai achhe se pach jata hai aur sarir swasth rahta hai. Haldi me paya jane wala anti oxidant gun har tarah se laabh dayak mana jata hai. Aapko bataye ki regular haldi ke istemal se pitt banta hai jo humare pachan me madad karta hai aur hajma bhi sahi rahta hai. Iske sevan se pet se related bimari dur hoti hai aur pet bhi saaf rahta hai. Isliye sabhi ko haldi ka istemal jarur karna chahiye.
- Skin ke liye – Haldi humari twacha ke liye kisi ayurvedic aoshadhi se kam nahi hai. Aap sabhi jante hai ki haldi me anti oxidant tatwa paye jate hai jo ki sarir ki sabhi paresani ko dur karte hai. Agar kisi ke sarir me kisi tarah ki sujan ho to aise me aap haldi ke powder me sarson ke tel ko milakar garam kar le. Ab iss paste ko aap unn sabhi bhago me malish kare jaha aapko dard ho ya sujan ho aur ya fir chott lag gayi ho. Aisa karne se aap ki sabhi paresani bahut jald dur ho jayegi.
- Chehre ke liye – Haldi ka istemal bahut se beauty products banane me kiya jata hai aap sabhi jante hai. Agar aap apni rukhi twacha ko komal banana chahte hai ya aapke chehre par kisi tarah ke daag dhabbe aur muhase ho to aise me aap agar haldi ka istemal kare to bahut fayda ho sakta hai. Haldi aur kale til ko milakar pees le aur iska paste bana le. Ab iss paste ko aap apne chehre par lagaye bahut laabh hoga. Aisa agar regular rup se kiya jaye to bahut fayda ho sakta hai.
- Sardi jukaam se rahat – Sardi ke maosam me hum dekhte hai ki bahut se log sardi jukaam aur naak bahne se paresan rahte hai. Aise me agar haldi ka sevan kiya jaye to bahut fayda mil sakta hai. Jo log sardi aur naak band hone se paresan hai unke liye bahut asaan sa tarike batau ki aap Haldi, Neem, Kali mirch aur shahad ko milakar sevan kare bahut laabh hoga. Itna hi nahi kali mirch ko pees kar shahad me bhigo de. Ab iska sevan aap regular rup se kare bahut fayda hoga.
- Dil ke liye – Haldi humare dil ke liye bahut achha mana jata hai kyuki isme prachur matra me anti oxidant paya jata hai jo heart se related bimari ko dur karne me madad karte hai. Aapko agar dil se related bimari ho to sabse achha tarika bataye ki Doodh me haldi ko milakar sevan kare bahut fayda hoga. Iske sevan se humara khoon swasth rahta hai aur kabhi bhi khoon jamne ki paresani nahi aati hai. Aur kabhi bhi heart attack jaisi paresani nahi aati aur isse nijad milta hai.
- Baalo ke liye – Haldi khane se humare bal bhi swasth rahte hai. Agar aap regular haldi ka sevan kare to bahut si bimari khud hi dur rah sakti hai. Aapko bataye ki haldi ke istemal se hum apne baalo ko bhi swasth rakh sakte hai. Agar kisi ke bal me koi paresani ho jaise baalo ka jhadna aur safed hona. Bahut se logo ke sarir me bahut adhik faltu ke bal hote hai unke liye bataye nariyal tel me haldi ko garam karke lagaye laabh hoga.
Dosto Haldi khane se humara sarir swasth rahta hai aur iske upyog se man aur dimag bhi sudhh rahta hai. Aur bhi haldi ke sevan se bahut fayde hai aiye jante hai.
- Haldi ke sevan se humara immune system bahut strong ho jata hai sath hi sarir ko ek nayi urja mil jati hai. Isliye sabhi ko haldi ka sevan jarur karna chahiye.
- Bahut se log motape se paresan rahte hai unke liye haldi powder ko garam doodh me milakar sevan kiya jaye bahut fayda mil sakta hai.
- Dosto chandan aur haldi ko mix karke chehre par lagaye isse aapke chehre par agar muhashe hai to usse chutkara mil sakta hai.
- Haldi ke istemal se hum cancer jaisi janleva bimari se bhi bach sakte hai.
Dosto Haldi humare sehat ka bahut khayal rakhti hai aur sabhi ke liye fayde mand hota hai. Haldi ka upyog bahut se gharo me kai tarah se hota hai aur fayda bhi bahut pahuchata hai. - Apne main keywords ko jyada repeat na kare isse Google keyword stuffing kehta hai aur ye aapke SEO ke liye bahut hi kharab hota hai.
Post URL
- Post URL waise to jyada SEO value nahi rakhta hai par aapko apne blog post title ko SEO friendly rakhna hoga. Post URL ko SEO friendly banane ke liye aapko apne article ke URL me apna main keywords use karna hoga.
- Post URL ko chota ya short rakhe aur jyada lamba na banaye isse Google like nahi karta hai aur spamming mai count karta hai.
- Google ke spam team ke head Matt cutts ka kehna hai ki Post URL mai jyada se jyada 4 to 5 keywords honte chahiye aur ye SEO friendly hai. Par mai kahunga ki 6 se 7 bhi ok hai par jab ye 10 se 11 se 15 tak pahunch jaye to ye sahi nahi hoga isliye aap apne post URL ko SEO friendly rakhe aur main keyword use kare.
- URL mai keywords ko alag karne ke liye aap kewal dash ( – ) ka istamal kare aur underscore ( _ ) ka istamal bilkul bhi na kare ye on page SEO ke liye kharab hota hai.
- Post URL mai numbers ka use na kare par agar koi situation hai jissme numbers use karna pade to usski matra kum se kum rakhe.
- Aap apne post URL ko SEO friendly banane ke liye wordpress me permalink settings change kar sakte hai aur blogger mai bhi custom URL ki help se aap apne URL ko SEO friendly bana sakte hai.
Keywords Research Kare
- Waise to Keywords research directly on page SEO ke tarike mai shamil nahi hota hai par ye aapke on page SEO karne mai bahut jyada jaruri hai. Kyunki agar aapko pata hi nahi hai ki mai sahi keywords use kar raha hu apne post mai to aapko jyada traffic kaise milega.
- To aapko keywords research karna hi hoga apne blog post likhne se pehle aur keyword research karne ke liye aap SEMrush keyword tool ya Google keyword planner ko use kar sakte hai.
- Aapko keyword research kyun jaruri hai isske bare mai next point me pata chal jayega. Agar mai kahu ki on page SEO mai sahi keywords ka use karna hi jyada mayane rakhta hai. To agar aap keyword research ko ignore kar rahe hai to aap bahut hi badi galti kar rahe hai.
- Bina sahi keyword research ke aap successful on page SEO karne me kamyab nahi ho paoge to aap kabhi bhi issko ignore na kare aur pure dhyaan se keyword research kare.
Keywords Ko Sahi Jagah Par Use Kare
- Keyword research karne ke baad aapko apne keywords ko sahi jagah par use karna hoga jaise ki maine bata ki post title aur post url aur isske alawa aapko keywords ko apne article ke starting ke 100 words me use karna hoga.
- Isske baad aapko kuch baar content ke beech mai aur phir akhir mai use karna hai. Par ek baat dhyaan me rakhe ki aapko keyword stuffing bilkul bhi nahi karna hai aur apne content ko natural tone mai rakhe aur na ki kewal search engine ko dhyaan me rakhkaar likhe.
- Aapko apne readers ko accha reading experience dena hi hoga tabhi wo apke blog ya website ki jyada visit karenge aur like bhi karenge aur agar aap keyword jarurat se jyada bar apne keywords ko apne article me use karenge to ye bad user experience dega apke readers ko.
Image SEO
- Ab ata hai image SEO aapko apne images ko SEO friendly banana hoga aur SEO optimize karne ke liye aapko apne images ke alt tag me apne main keywords ko use karna hai.
- Aap apne image ko upload karte waqt alt tag de sakte hai aur radh rakhe ye aapke image ko acche se describe karna chahiye jaise ki yadi man lo ki aapne ek car ki image upload ki hai aur aap alt tag mai dog food keyword use kar rahe hai to ye bahut galat hai on page SEO ke liye aapko sahi keywords se apne image ko describe karna hoga.
- Kyuki Google aapke images ko samaj nahi pata hai aur alt tag ki wajah se Google ko pata chalta hai ki aapka image kiske bare mai hai to aapko sahi keywords use karna hoga.
- Aur ek cheez jo nahi hindi bloggers bahut jyada matra me karte hai ki wo apne alt tag me to sahi keywords use karte hai par ek cheez wo bhul jaate hai ki image file upload karte waqt wo uske file name ko change nahi karte aur ye bahut badi galti hoti hai SEO ke nazaar se.
- Aap jab kabhi bhi koi image download karte hai to image ke file ko save karte waqt aap apne keywords se us file ko save kare aur ye aapke blog post ko aur bhi jyada SEO friendly bana dega.
- Image ke upload hone ke baad uske size ko aur bhi kum kare aur aisa karne ke liye aap wp smush it plugin ko download kar sakte hai ye aapke bade image size ko chotha karta hai jisse aapke blog loading speed me bahut jyada fayada hota hai.
Sahi Tags use karna
- Waise to tags jyada SEO me value nahi rakhte par yadi aap use kar rahe hai to apko sahi tags use karna hoga. Jaise ki aap aga post likh rahe hai SEO ke bare mai aur aap tag use kar rahe hai affiliate marketing to ye galat hoga.
- Aapke tags apke post ya article kis bare mai hai ye describe karna hoga dosto. Uddharan ke taur pe agar mai aapko batau to jaise ke ye post on page SEO ke bare mai hai to mai tag use karunga on page seo, on page SEO optimization ityadi aur koi unrelated tags use nahi karunga aur dhyaan rakhe ki 4 se 5 tags se jyada kabhi bhi use na kare.
Sahi Categories me post karna
- Tags ki tarah aapko apne post ya article ko sahi category me post karna hoga jaise ki aap agar blogging tips de rahe hai to aapko blogging tips ke category me apne post ko publish karna hoga aur na ki make money online ki category mai.
- Waise to hum ek post ko ek se jyada categories me post kar sakte hai par aapk isko jitna kam rakhe to sahi hoga. Aisa na ho ki aap apne har ek post ko apne har ek category me post kar rahe hai ye user experience ko bahut kharab kar dega aur apka content sahi se organize nahi dekhai dega.
- Yaad rakhe ki aapko apne tags aur categories ko no index karna hoga aur ye duplicate content ko avoid karega jisse aapka on page SEO bahut hi jyada strong ho jayega. Issko kaise karte hai isske bare mai mai apko next point me discuss karunga
SEO By Yoast Plugin Download Kare
- Chahe aap kitne bhi SEO expert kyun na ho par aap aksaar koi na koi galti kar jate hai par ye galti na karne ke liye aap ek behatarin plugin jo free me download kar sakte hai uska naam hai SEO by yoast.
- Ye sabse best SEO plugin hai wordpress blogs ke liye is time par to mai aapko salah dunga ki ye plugin ko jarrur download kare aur apki help ke liye ye raha direct download link – Download SEO by yoast plugin
- Ye plugin aapke on page SEO ko perfect banane me bahut hi jyada help karega aur agar aap kahi par bhi galti kar rahe hai to ye aapko sachet karega to is plugin ko jarrur download kare.
Keywords Stuffing Na Kare
- Keywords stuffing ka matlab ye hota hai ki aap jarurat se bahut jyada time apne main keywords ko apne article me use karte hai aur ye Google bahut hate karta hai jisse aapke blog ya website ke SEO pe bahut hi bura asar padta hai.
- Agar aap bhi keyword stuffing ye soch kar karte hai ki aapko acchi ranking milegi to aap ye karna bilkul bhi band kar dijiye kyunki isse aapko aachi ranking to nahi milegi par aapko penality jarrur mil jayegi Google ki taraf se aur apke SEO me bahut jyada bura assar hoga.
- Apne keywords ko natural tarike se apne blog post ya content me use kare jisse apke readers ko apke article ko padhne me accha lage aur Google ko bhi aapka content quality content lage aur na ki keyword stuffed content.
Internal linking Kare
- Internal linking On page SEO ka bahut hi ahehem hissa hai aur aapko humesha internal linking karna hoga apne blog ya website me.
- Internal linking se aapke on page SEO bahut strong ho jati hai aur Google bhi issko bahut like karta hai.
- Internal linking se aapke readers ko bahut accha reading experience hota hai aur Google ka bhi yehi aim hai to agar aap apne user ko accha experience yani ke unko useful interlinking karenge to Google aapke content ko full marks dega kyunki aap apne readers ko us topic ke related jyada se jyada information dene ki kosish kar rahe hai.
- Humesha apne naye content ko purane content se link kare aur purane content se naye content ko link kare. Aisa karne se aapke purani post ki ranking acchi hogi aur jyada readers ussko padhenge.
- Interlink karte samay aap keywords ka use kare jaise ki agar aap SEO tips aand tricks wale post ko link karna chahte hai to aapko SEO tips and tricks keywords se link karna hoga naki Click here. Ye On page SEO le liye ko fayada nahi dega.
- Uddharan ke taur pe aap dekh sakte hai ki maine kaise apne SEO tips and tricks wale post ko apne keywords se interlink kiya hai isse us post ki ranking Google me badh jayegi.
- Ek cheej jo mai aapse share karna chahunga ki aapko humesha ek hi keywords se interlink nahi karna hai aur apne keywords ko badalte rahe.
External linking kare
- Jaise internal linking apke user experience ko badhata hai waise hi external link bhi apke readers ko jyada information dene me help karta hai.
- Aap jab kabhi bhi koi bhi article likh rahe ho to aap kosish kare ki us article ke related koi bhi anya external articles ko link kare isse Google ko pata chalta hai ki aapka article kiske bare mai hai aur aap apne readers ko jyada se jyada jankari dena chahte hai.
- Google ye appreciate karta hai aur aapko acchi ranking bhi deta hai kyunki aap users ke liye best content provide karne ki kosish karte hai.
- Wikipedia ek aisi website hai jiss par aapko har koi topic ke bare me to aap kosish kare ki apne article mai kam se kam ek external link jarrur dale but personally mai aisa nahi karta par karna chahiye.
Bada Detailed Article Post Kare
- Ye bahut hi jaruri hai ki aap detailed aur bada article post kare isse aapko acchi ranking milne mai bahut hi jyada help hogi. Ek survey ke anusar jyadatar post jo first page me rank hoti hai wo aksaar 2000 words se jyada ki hoti hai.
- To aap bhi kosish kare ki apne post ko jyada bada likhe yani 2000 se jyada par ek baat bahut jaruri hai yaha par ki aap bina koi reason ke article ko lamba karne ki koi bhi jarurat nahi hai. Agar situation demand karti hai to hi apne article ko lamba likhe warna aapke readers ko accha nahi lagega.
- Kyunki aapke readers ke paas jyada time nahi hota hai aur wo jaldi se jaldi behatar jankari pana chahte hai aur agar aapne janbuchkar apne article ko jarurat se jyada lamba kheecha to wo aapke blog me ana pasanad nahi karenge to please dosto is baat ka jarrur dhyaan rakhe.
- Man lo ki aap post likh rahe hai ki blogger mai free blog kaise banaye aur ussme aap wordpress mai kaise blog banaye ki bhi janakari de rahe hai to aapke readers ko ye bilkul bhi accha nahi lagega kyunki aap bina wajah ke unko wordpress ki jankari de rahe hai wo to sirf blogger me apna blog banana chahte hai.
- To mera point aap samajhi gaye honge dosto to aapko agar situation demand karti hai to hi apne article ko lamba likhna hai warna nahi.
Heading Tags
- Heading tags ka sahi se use kare humare paas h1 se h6 tak ke heading tags hote hai par issko aapko sahi tarike se use karna hoga kyunki ye on page seo ke liye bahut jaruri hai.
- h1 tag aap sirf apne blog post ya article ke title ke liye hi use kare aur kisi ke liye bhi nahi. Aapke article me sirf aur sirf ek hi h1 tag hona chahiye aur koi dusra nahi.
- h2 tag aap apne sub heading ke liye use kare aur h3 tags aapke sub-sub-headings ke liye use kare aur chote points jo aapke sub headings ke andaar ate hai.
- h4 se h6 ko use karne ki koi bhi jarurat nahi hai kyunki ye aapke sidebars me widgets ke heading ke liye use hote hai aur SEO mai issa jyada value nahi hoti hai.
- Heading tags ka sahi istamal karne se aap apne blog post ko highly seo friendly bana sakte hai to aap inko sahi se use kare apne article me.
Meta Tags
- Waise to bahut se meta tags hote hai par humare liye on page SEO ke liye meta description hi sabse jyada jaruri hota hai. Pehle meta keywords bhi jaruri hota tha par spammers ne issko itna jyada spam kiya ki Google ne isski value ko bilkul hi hata diya hai to ab aapko meta keywords use nahi karna chahiye.
- Sirf aapko meta description use karna hoga kyunki ye meta description Google search results me show hota hai aur ye aapke CTR ( click through rate ) ko badha sakta hai. To aap apne har ek article ya blog post ko meta description jarrur de.
- Meta description add karne ke liye aap SEO by yoast plugin apne blog me download kare aur download karne ke baad aap post likhne ke baad niche jaye SEO by yoast section me aur Edit Snippet pe click kare. Yaha par aap apne blog post ke liye meta description likh sakte hai jo ki bahut hi jaruri hai on page SEO ke liye.
Website / Blog loading speed
- Waise dekha jaye to website ya blog loading speed directly on page SEO me nahi ata hai ye on site SEO me ata hai to be precise lekin hum isse on page SEO me count kar sakte hai.
- Blog ya website loading speed bhi bahut jaruri hai kyunki jab koi reader aapke page par visit karta hai to usse bahut jaldi load hona bahut hi jaruri hai aur agar page load hone me bahut jyada time lagta hai to apke readers back button press kar denge ya phir koi dusre website ya blog me jankari lene ke liye chale jayenge.
- Aisa hone se aapka bounce rate badh jata hai aur se SEO ke nazariye se bahut hi kharab hai aur Google phir aapke article ke ranking ko down kar dega joki I am sure aap bilkul bhi nahi chahenge right?
- To aapko apne blog ya website ko fast loading speed ke bare me sochna hoga aur isske liye aap wp total cache plugin intall kare aur Free cloudfare CDN ka use kare ye aapke blog ya webiste ki loading speed ko bahut improve karega.
- Aap bahut se befijool ke widgets install na kare aur na hi plugins ye aapke blog ya website ko slow karti hai aur aap utne hi widgets ya plugins ko install kare jisski aapko bahut jyada jarurat hai.
- Apne Website ke images ko compress kare jaise ki maine image SEO section me bataya tha.
LSI Keywords Use Kare
- Ye term aapke liye naya hoga aur sayad bahut se nayi hindi bloggers ko pata bhi nahi hoga. LSI keywords ka matlab hai latent semantic keywords ye aapke main keywords ke related keywords hote hai.
- Jaise ki aapka keywords hai ki blogging kaise start kare to LSI keywords hoga blogging kaise kare ye dono related keywords hote hai aur Google ko batate hai ki aapka post kis topic par hai.
- LSI keywords aapko keyword stuffing se bhi bachata hai aur aapko issko jarrur use karna hota hai apne articles me. LSi keywords ka dursa bahut bada fyada ye hai ki aapka blog post bahut sare dusre similiar keywords ke liye bhi rank karne lag jayega jisse aapko jyada traffic milega.
- LSI keywords ke liye aap apne main keywords ko Google search me search kare aur niche scroll kare. Yaha par aapko LSI keywords milenge aur wo hi keywords use kare jo aapke post ke related hai.
Rich Media Content likhe
- Google Rich media content ko bahut jyada like karta hai. Rich media content ka matlab hai ki aap apne post me images, videos, infographics ka use karne se aap apne blog post ya article ko rich media content bana sakte hai.
- Rich media content ko bahut acchi ranking milti hai agar aapne apne dusre on page SEO factors ko sahi tarike se kiya hai to.
- Rich media content aapko traffic badhane me bhi bahut hi jyada use karega aur backinks pane me kyunki agar aapke content ko aapke readers like karenge to wo use share bhi karenge facebook ya twitter par aur bahut se bloggers apke content ko link bhi karenge jisse aapko high quality backlinks bhi milege aur ye aapke blog ya website ke SEO ke liye bahut hi jaruri hota hai.
- To aap humesha kosish kare ki apne article me images, videos aur infographics ho sakte to jarrur add kare.
Quality Content likhe
- Aap chahe kitna bhi accha on page SEO kar le par agar aap quality content nahi likh rahe hai to aap bahut badi galti kar rahe hai. Quality content sabse jyada jaruri hai aur isske bagair aapko na to accha traffic milega aur na hi high ranking.
- Quality content se aapko backlinks milne mai bahut asani hogi aur aapki ranking bhi bahut jyada badh jayegi. Quality content likhne ke liye aap apne topic ke bare me bahut jyada research kare aur phir apna article likhe ye aapko bahut jyada help karegi.
- Jald baazi me article na likhe kyunki aapka article phir quality content nahi kehlayega pure research karne ke baad hi apna article likhe.
- Maine ek bahut hi detailed guide likhi hai isse bare me jo aap yaha padh sakte hai – quality content kaise likhe
Stop words Ko Remove kar sakte hai
- Waise to mai stop words me jyada dhyaan nahi deta hu par bahut se bloggers ka kehna hai ki stop words ko URL me use nahi karna chahiye.
- To agar aapko stop words ko remove karna hai to aap SEO by yoast plugin ke help se kar sakte hai.
- Stop words to, the, a, in, and jaise words ko bolte hai aur ye words ko Google search query me ignore karta hai jisski wajah se log isse avoid karte hai.
SEO Friendly URL Rakhe
- Ye bhi on page SEO ke liye jaruri hai aur apko apne blog post ya article ke URL ko seo friendly rakhna hoga.
- Aap ko apne URL chota rakha hai aur apne main keywords ka use karna hai yaha par.
- Jyada lamba URL na banaye ye SEO friendly nahi hota hai.
- Aap wordpress me custom permalink set kar sakte hai aur blogger me aap manually apne permalink ko edit kar sakte hai.
- URL me numbers ka prayog bahut kam kar aur ho sakte to agar bahut jyada use nahi hai to bilkul bhi na kare.
- URL me jyada se jyada 4 se 5 keywords ka use kare ye 6 se 7 bhi ho sakta hai agar situation jyada demand karti hai to lekin agar ye 10 se jyada ho to bahut gharab hai SEO ke point of view se.
Keywords Ko Highlight kare
- Apne main keywords ko aap highlight kar sakte hai jaise ki aap apne keywords ko bold, italize aur underline kar sakte hai jisse Google bots unpe jyada dhyaan de aur apke article kis bare me hai wo samaj paye.
- Aisa kare se jyada SEO benefit nahi milata par ye aapke user experience ko bahut jyada badha deta hai aur aapke user ko pata chalega ki aapka content highly relevant hai unke liye aur wo sahi post padh rahe hai.

Dosto agar aapke maan me koi bhi doubt ya question hai to aap bejijhak hokar mujhse comments ke madhyam se puch sakte hai aur mai aapke har ek question ya doubt ka uttar dunga. After four consequent electoral defeats, Parakala withdrew from the electoral arena. He concentrated on public discourse through the current affairs programmes on television and his profession as a policy analyst. But in 2008 some like minded people approached Parakala with an intention to start a new alternative political platform. Popular matinee idol Chiramjivi was to be the face of the party. Parakala lent his support to the idea and worked to establish the party. He was one of the signatories to the application for the registration of the Political Party 'Prajarajyam' and one of its founding General Secretaries and spokespersons. But the experimented turned out to be another disappointment for Parakala. He found that there was no clear agenda and party tickets were given in exchange of money. Several local leaders openly hurled accusations at the party leadership. Parakala held a press conference at the party headquarters and launched a scathing attack on the party leadership for betraying the ideals for which the new platform was to stand for. Terming the party as Poisonous Ivy (Vishavruksham), he announced his resignation. That address to the press was telecast live and thousands viewed it across the state. That spelt the doom for the party. A party that was hoping to have an impressive performance ended up with securing just 18 seats with the charismatic Chiramjivi himself losing one of the two seats he contested from his native place. Many people still question the moral and ethical basis of Parakala holding a press conference at the party headquarters to criticise the party and its leadership. Opinion is still bitterly divided on this. The Prajarajyam seems to have put an end to the party and electoral political career of Parakala.

London England ke poorv salaami ballebaaj Geoffrey boycott ne bhaarateeya team ki aalochna karte hue mehmaan team ke ballebaaji pradarshan ko 'Anubhavaheen, gairajimmedaaraana aur bevakoofi ke kareeb' karaar diya hai. Boycott ne 'Daily teleegraaf' mein apne kaalam mein likha, 'Ab tak bhaarateeya khilaadiyon ne swayam ko aur apne samarthakon ko niraash kiya hai. Ballebaaji itni anubhavaheen aur gairajimmedaaraana thi ki yeh bevakoofi ke kareeb thi. Aautasving hoti geindon par drive khelne ki kalpana bhi naheen ki ja sakti. ' Salaami ballebaaj murali vijay ke out hone ke tareekon ke sandarbh mein boycott ka maanana hai ki out-swinger ko flick karte hue bhaarateeya ballebaajon mein jajba naheen dikha. Unhonne kaha, 'Seedhi aautasving geind ko mid-wicket par khelne ki koshish karna aur iske baad bold hone ya balle ka kinaara lagne par hairaan hona bevakoofaana hai. Geind ko apne pad ke saamane to khelna hi naheen chaahiye. ' boycott ka maanana hai ki bhaarateeya ballebaajon ke out hone ke tareeke se pata chalta hai ki unhonne sahi taiyaari naheen ki. Padhein: Kya viraat ab is tihre shatakaveer ko deinge mauka? Unhonne kaha, 'Ye chhoti moti cheejein hain, jo aapko England ke haalaat mein theek-thaak swing geindabaaj ke khilaaf bhi naheen karni chaahiye. Aisi cheejein James Anderson ke khilaaf karne ki koshish karna, jo in haalaat mein diggajon mein se ek hai, bataata hai ki bhaarateeya ballebaajon ne sahi taiyaari naheen ki hai. ' test cricket mein 8 hajaar se adhik run banaane vaale boycott ne bhaarateeyon ko lagbhag sapaat wicketon ka sher tak kah diya. Unhonne kaha, 'In ladkon ko Bhaarat mein sapaat, sookhe, kam uchhaal waali pichon par ballebaaji aur aasaan run banaane ki aadat hai. Nai geind kaafi kuchh naheen karti aur aap kaafi shot seedhe khel sakte ho. ' Padhein: Bhaarateeya ballebaajon ki taiyaariyon mein kami saaf jhalak rahi hai: Suneel gaavasakar Boycott ne kaha, 'Bhaarat aatmamugdhata ka shikaar hokar England aaya. Ahankaar mein soch rahe the ki ve isi tareeke se ballebaaji kar paaenge aur sab kuchh theek rahega. Jab bhi aap yojana naheen banaaenge aur apne cricket par kaam naheen kareinge, to aapko khaamiyaaja bhugatna hoga aur Bhaarat is karaari haar ka hakdaar hai jo use mil rahi hai. ' boycott ne saath hi bhaarateeyon ko chetaaya ki treintabrij mein Anderson aur adhik khatarnaak honge, jahaan teesara test shanivaar ko shuroo hoga.

Exercise Cycle Benefits: Fit and Slim Dikhne Ka Raaz
Kya aap jante hai ki aapke sharir ka nichla hissa strong ho jaye. Kya aap kisi aise acche magical instrument ki talash me hai jo ye kaam aasan kar de. To aaiye aaj hum aapko Exercise Cycle Benefits batate hai.
Jin logo ko gym jane me aalas aata hai, khas unke liye ye ek adbudh cycle hai jisse aap ghar par hi kuch aisa kar sakte hai jisse unka sharir fit rahe aur wo sahi tarike se exercise bhi kar sake.
Har gym me ek exercise bike hoti hai jo aap sabhi ne dekhi hi hogi. Ek bike ek cycle ki tarah hi dikhti hai jisme saddle, pedal, handlebar aur ek monitor bhi hota hai, jo chalane wale ka workout timing dikhata hai. To aaj se hi isse apne daily workout me shamil kijiye aur slim dikhiye.
Exercise Cycle Benefits: Paiye Dhero Swasth Laabh
Exercise Cycle Benefits itne hai ki ye aapki body ko fit aur slim bana sakta hai aur aapko tandaroost bana sakta hai. Iss Cycle ya bike ke kai swasth laabh hote hai, jo ki kuch iss prakar hai:
You may also like: Cycling Vs Running Which Is Better for Weight Loss- Get the Answer
1) Cardio Option:
Iss cycle se har din exercise karne se heart ko kafi aaram milta hai. Aapke sharir ka blood glucose balance rehta hai, dil me rakt sanchar acchi tarah hota hai. Isse dil aur saans lene ki kshamta me bhi increment hota hai.
2) Majboot Karne Wali Training:
Cycling karne se sharir ka nichla hissa fit rehta hai aur usme majbooti bhi aati hai jisse aapko kamar dard aadi pareshani nahi hoti hai. Lagatar cycling karne se bhi kafi fayda hota hai aur aapke muscles bhi majboot ho jate hai.
3) Vajan Ghatana:
Agar aap apna vajan kam karna chahte hai to har din 15 minutes iss cycle par bitaye. Cycling karne se aapke sharir ka fat ghatega kyuki calorie ki khapat jyada hogi.
4) Jodo Ka Dard:
Jodo me dard ki samasya hpone lagi hai to aap iss cycle ka istemaal kare. Exercise cycle ko chalane se jodo ke dard me aaram milti hai. Jab aap pedal marte hai to aapke joints ghumte hai aur unme gati hoti hai jisse dard dur hota jata hai.
5) Nichle Hisse Ke Liye Vardaan:
Exercise Cycle, sharir ke lower part ke liye kisi vardaan se kam nahi hai. Fat thighs patli ho jati hai. Pairo me majbooti aati hai aur bhari kamar me bhi lachak aa jati hai.
Aaj Aapne jane Exercise Cycle Benefits. To der kis baat ki aaj se apne daily schedule me iska prayog shamil kar dijiye aur fayda uthaiye inn dhero swasth laabh ka jo aapke sharir me majbooti pradan karega aur aapko ek alag hi fitness dega.

association football jise aamtaur par sirf football (angreji: foot: paad ya pag, baul: geind) ya saukar kaha jaata hai, duniya ke sabse lokapriya khelon me se ek hai. yeh ek saamoohik khel hai aur ise gyaarah khilaadiyon ke do dalon ke beech khela jaata hain. football ko saamaanyat: ek aayataakaar ghaas ya krutrim ghaas ke maidaan par khela jaata hai jiske donon chhoron par ek ek gol hota hai. khilaadiyon dvaara virodhi dal ke gol me chaalaaki se geind ko daalna hi is khel ka uddeshya hai. khel mein golarakshak hi ek maatr aisa khilaadi hota hai jise geind ko rokane ke liye apna haath istemaal karne ki anumati hoti hai; dal ke baaki khilaadi aamtaur par geind ko maarane (kick ya padaaghaat) ke liye apne pair ka istemaal karte hain tatha kabhi kabhi hava mein geind ko rokane ke liye ve apne dhad ya fir sir ka istemaal karte hain. jo dal khel ke ant ya samay samaapti tak jyaada gol karta hai, vijayi rahata hai. khel ke ant yaani samay samaapti tak yadi score baraabar rahe to us mukaabale ko baraabar ya dra ghoshit karna, ya khel ko atirikt samay me le jaana aur/ya penalty shoot out ke dvaara haar jeet ka faisala karna sab pratiyogita ke svarup par nirbhar karta hai.
aadhunik football ko England me the football association (football sangh) ke gathan ke saath kootabaddh kiya gaya aur jiske 1863 mein bane lauj of the game (khel ke kaanoon) ke aadhaar par hi aaj football kheli jaati hai. antararaashtreeya aadhaar par football ka niyantran Féadéaration Internationale de Football Association (federation intaraneshanel di football association) ya association football ka antararaashtreeya mahaasangh jise sankshep mein FIFA ya FIFA kaha jaata hai, karta hai. football ki sabse pratishthit antararaashtreeya aur lokapriya pratiyogita FIFA vishv cup hai, jiska aayojan har chauthe varsh kiya jaata hai. is pratiyogita ko vyaapak roop se poore vishv mein dekha jaata hai aur iske darshak greeshmakaaleen olympic khelon ko mile darshakon se lagbhag dugane hote hain.

football kuchh niyamon ke anusaar khela jaata hai jise khel ka niyam (Laws of the Game) kaha jaata hai yeh khel ek gol geind ka upayog karte hue khela jaata hai, jo football (football) ke naam se jaana jaata hai gyaarah khilaadiyon ki do teemein hoti hai jismein pratyek khilaadi doosari team ke gol post mein geind daalne ki koshish karti hai jisse gol praapt kiye jaate hain (post aur rekha ke andar) jo team khel ke ant tak jyaada gol karti hai vah team vijeta hoti hai, agar donon hi teemein samaan gol karte hain to khel dra ho jaati hai.
khilaadi khelne ke dauraan (gol keepar (goalkeepers) ko chhod kar) jaan bujhakar apne haath ya baah se geind ko heindal nahi kar sakta yeh khel ka praathamik niyam hai (haalaaainki ve apne haatho ka istemaal geind ko baahar se andar feinkane (throw-in) ke dauraan kar sakte hain) haalaaainki khilaadi aam taur par geind ko sthaanaantarit karne ke liye apne pairon ka istemaal karte hain, ve haathon ko chhod kar apne shareer ke kisi bhi ang ka istemaal kar sakte hain[1]
is vishisht khel mein khilaadi apne vyaktik niyantran jaise dribling (dribbling), apne team ke khilaadiyon ko geind dena aur gol post mein gol maarana jahaaain virodhi team ka gol keepar ke dvaara raksha kiya jaata hai ke maadhyam se gol scoring avsaron ka nirmaan karta hai. virodhi khilaadi geind ko ek dusare ko dete samay geind ko apne kabje lene ki koshish tatha pratidvandi se nibatne ke maadhyam se geind par niyantran kar sakte hain, lekin virodhiyon se shaareerik sampark seemaabaddh hai aam taur par football na rukane wala khel hai yeh khel tabhi rookati hai jab geind maidaan se baahar na jaae ya referee (referee) ke dvaara khel ko na roka jaae thaharaav ke baad khel nirdisht samay ke liye fir se shuroo hoti hai[2]
ek peshevar star par adhiktar maichon mein kuchh hi gol ban paate hain. udaaharan svarup, varsh 2005 -06 ke mausam (2005–06 season) mein english premiyer league (Premier League) ek match[3] mein 2.48 ke ausat se gol bana saki khel ke niyamon mein gol keepar[4] ko chhod kar kisi bhi khilaadi ka sthaan nirdhaarit nahi hai, lekin anek nanbaron mein vishesh bhoomikaaon (specialised roles) ko dikhaaya hai mote taur par mukhya roop se ismein teen shreniyaan shaamil hai; striker (striker), ya aage, jiska mukhya kaarya gol maarana hota hai; rakshak (defenders), jo vishesh roop se apne virodhiyon ko gol score karne se rokata hai; aur beech ka khilaadi (midfielder) jo vipakshi ke geind ke oopar se adhikaar chheen kar apne aage khelne vaale khilaadiyon ko geind dene ka kaarya karta hai. is prakaar ke khilaadiyon ko aautafeeld khilaadi ke roop mein ullekh kiya jaata hai, jo gol keepar ke saath pahachaana jaata hai maidaan ke kshetr ke anusaar in sthaanon ko pratibhaag kiya jaata hai jahaaain khilaadi jyaadaatar samay bitaate hain. udaaharan ke liye, vahaaain kendriye rakshak aur baaen aur daayein ke madhyasth khilaadi rahate hain. is das aautafild khilaadiyon ka sanyojan kisi bhi vyastha mein kiya ja sakta hai. pratyek sthaan ke anek khilaadi team ke khelne ki shaili ko apnaate hain; adhiktar aage ke khilaadi aur kuchh rakshak khilaadi uttejit aur aakraamak- dimaagi khel ki rachana karte hain, jab vipakshi dheere tatha aatmarakshak shaili ko apnaate hain jab ek khilaadi adhiktar khelon mein ek vishisht sthaan mein khelta hai, tak khilaadi ke chaal mein kuchh pratibndh hote hain aur khilaadi ko kisi bhi samay us sthaan ko chhodna padta hai.[5] team ke khilaadiyon ki kshaitij rooparekha ko banaavat/nirmaan (formation) ke roop mein jaana jaata hai. aam taur par team ka gathan aur rananeeti par team ke prabandhak (manager)[6] ka vishesh adhikaar hota hai.

geind ko maarane wala khel par vichaar karne par maaloom padta hai ki anek deshon mein yeh khela gaya hai FIFA (FIFA) ke anusaar "khel ka praarambhik shaili jahaaain vaigyaanik saboot hai ki yeh kushal takaneek China mein isa poorv doosari tatha teesari sadi meingh khsytgs paaya gaya hai" (kujoo (cuju) ka khel)[7] iske atirikt roman khel harpastam (harpastum) football ka door ka poorvaj ho sakta hai. madhyakaaleen Europe mein football ko anek roopon mein khela gaya hai (football were played in medieval Europe), yadyapi samay aur sthaan donon ke aadhaar par niyam alag alag hote the. madhya 19 veen shataabdi mein vyaapak roop se football ke vibhinn roop ke saath England ke pablik school mein khela gaya tha, football ke aadhunik niyam par aadhaarit tha.
Cambridge niyam (Cambridge Rules) sabse pehle 1848 mein Cambridge vishvavidyaalaya mein taiyaar kiya gaya tha, jo vishesh roop se baad ke code ke vikaas mein prabhaavashaali rahe jismein football sanstha bhi shaamil thi. kembrij niyam ko triniti college, kembrij (Trinity College, Cambridge) mein likha gaya, ek baithak mein etan (Eton), harro (Harrow),ragbi (Rugby),vinchestar (Winchester) aur shrevsburi (Shrewsbury) schoolon ke pratinidhiyon ne bhaag liya tha. unhein sarvagat apnaaya naheen gaya tha 1850s, ke dauraan anek club school ya vishvavidyaalaya se sambaddh nahi the unhonne angreji bolne waali vishv mein football khelne ke vibhinn roopon ko banaaya tha. kuchh apne niyamon ke vishisht code ke saath aae sabse khaaskar shefild football club (Sheffield Football Club) tha jo poorv pablik school ke dvaara 1857,[8] mein gathit hua tha jo 1867 shefild ऍf ai (Sheffield FA) ka gathan ka netrutv kiya. 1862 mein uppingham school (Uppingham School) ke John Charles thring (John Charles Thring) ne prabhaav janak niyamon ka jattha banaaya.[9]
in chal rahe prayaason ne 1863 mein football asosiyeshan/sansthaaon (The Football Association) ke nirmaan mein yogadaan diya, jo sabse pehle 26 October (26 October) 1863 ke subah mein great kuin street (Great Queen Street) ke free mesan, tavern landan mein aayojan hua.[10] is avsar par pratinidhitv karne wala chaartar house (Charterhouse) ekamaatr school tha. free mesan tavern ne October aur December ke beech pauainch aur baithakon ka aayojan kiya jo antat: pehla niyamon ka jattha banaaya.antim baithak mein pehla ऍf ai koshaadhyaksh, blaikahith (Blackheath) ke pratinidhi ne pichhle baithak mein do praaroop niyamon ko hataane ke kaaran ऍf ai se apna club vaapas le liya, pehla jo haath mein geind lekar daudne ki anumati tatha doosra anadhikrut pravesh, thokar maarana tatha pakadte hue daudna mein pratibndh lagaana anya english ragbi football club ne is netrutv (English rugby football clubs followed this lead) ka paalan kiya aur ऍf ai mein sammilit nahi hue, ya ऍf ai ko chhod diya aur 1871 mein ragbi football sangh (Rugby Football Union) ka gathan kiya. shesh ke gyaarah club jo ebenejr kab morle (Ebenezer Cobb Morley) ke tahat the ve khel ke mool terah niyamon ki pushti karne ke liye chale gaye.[10] geind ko chinh ke sthaan se haath se fekane ka niyam viktoriyn football niyam (Victorian rules football) ke samaan hi niyam banaaya gaya jo us samay Australia mein viksit tha. shefild ऍf ai ne 1870 tak apne niyamon ke aadhaar par khelte rahe, ऍf ai ne iske kuchh niyam aatmasaat kar liye jisse khel mein thoda hi antar rah gaya.
vartamaan mein khel ke niyam antararaashtreeya football association board (International Football Association Board) ke dvaara nirdhaarit hai.menachestar (Manchester) football asosiyeshan, skautish football asosiyeshan (Scottish Football Association), vels football asosiyeshan (Football Association of Wales) aur aayarish football asosiyeshan (Irish Football Association) ke aapasi baithak ke baad 1886[11] mein is board ka gathan hua.ऍf ai cup (FA Cup) vishv ki sabse puraani pratiyogita hai jiski sthaapana si dabloo alkokk (C. W. Alcock) ne kiya tha aur 1872 se english teemon mein yeh pratiyogita ho rahi hai pehla aadhikaarik antararaashtreeya football match (first official international football match) fir se si dabloo alkokk ke parikshan mein 1872 mein skautlaind aur England ke beech glaasago mein khela gaya. England duniya mein pehla football league (football league) ka ghar hai jiski sthaapana 1888 mein aston (Aston Villa) villa nirdeshak William mak grejor (William McGregor) dvaara birmingham (Birmingham) mein hui thi.[12] mool svarup midlaind aur uttari England ke baarah club mein antarvisht hai. federation international the football asosiyeshan (FIFA), antararaashtreeya football sanstha ka gathan 1904 mein peris mein hua tha aur ghoshana ki gayi thi ki football asosiyeshan[13] khel ke niyamon ka paalan karna hoga. 1913 mein FIFA antararaashtreeya football asosiyeshan board (International Football Association Board) ke pratinidhitv ke pravesh ke kaaran antararaashtreeya khel mein lokapriyta badhi.vartamaan mein FIFA ke chaar pratinidhi aur chaaron british asosiyeshan ka ek pratinidhi board mein shaamil hai.
aaj football vyavasaayik star par puri duniya mein khela jaata hai. apne pasandeeda teemon[14] ka anukaran karne ke liye laakho log niyamit roop se football maidaan jaate hain jabki arabon log telivijn[15] par is khel ko dekhte hain logon ki ek badhi sankhya apne shauk ke star par football khelte hain. FIFA ke dvaara aayojit ek sarvekshan mein takreeban do sau deshon ke do sau chaalees se bhi jyaada log niyamit roop se football khelte hain jo 2001 mein prakaashit hui thi.[16] ismein koi sandeh naheen iske saadhaaran niyam tatha kam upakaran ki aavashyakataaon ke kaaran iske prasaar tatha lokapriyta mein vruddhi hui hai.
vishv ke anek bhaagon mein football vyakti ke jeevan, prashansak (fan), sthaaneeya sammudaayon aur deshon mein bhi mein ek joonoon paida karta hai tatha mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhaata hai; iseeliye ise duniya ka sabse lokapriya khel maana jaata hai.iesapeeen (ESPN) ne yeh dev ke saath kaha tha ki kote delvoire raashtreeya football team (Côate d'Ivoire national football team) ne thode samay ke liye 2005 mein desh ki naagrik yuddh ko viraam dene mein madat ki thi. iske vipreet, 1969 mein L salvaador aur honduraas ke beech jo football yuddh (Football War) hua tha use football jo vyaapak taur par faila hua hai, antim aasann kaaran maana jaata hai[17] yeh khel 1990 ke yugoslaav yuddh (Yugoslav wars) ke shuruaat mein tanaav paida kar diya tha, jab dinmo jgareb (Dinamo Zagreb) aur red star belagred ([[en:Red Star Belgrade|Red Sta

khel ke niyam
aadhikaarik khel ke niyamon (Laws of the Game) mein satrah niyam hain. football ke sabhi star mein vahi niyam laagu hote hain jabki kuchh samoohon jaise junior, bujurg ya mahilaaon ke liye kuchh sanshodhan ki anumati di jaati hai. aksar niyam vyaapak drushti ke liye bane hote hain, jo khel ke svarup ke aadhaar par lacheelaapan pradaan karta hai. satrah niyamon ke aalaava aaiऍfaibi ki kai faisalein aur anya nirdesh football ke niyman mein yogadaan deta hai. FIFA ke dvaara khel ke niyam prakaashit kiye gaye hain lekin FIFA ke dvaara hi nahi balki antararaashtreeya football asosiyeshan board (International Football Association Board) ke dvaara banaaye rakha gaya hai[19]
khilaadi, upakaran aur karmachaari
pratyek team mein adhiktam gyaarah khilaadi hote hain (atirikt khilaadi (substitute) ko chhodkar) usamein se ek khilaadi goalkeeper (goalkeeper) hona chaahiye.pratiyogita kaanoon bata sakta hai ki ek team ko banaane mein kitne khilaadiyon ki aavashyakta hoti hai; aamtaur par saat hote hain. gol keepar ekamaatr aisa khilaadi hota hai jo apne haath ya baanh mein geind pakad kar khelne ki anumati hoti hai lekin vah apne gol ke saamane penalty kshetr (penalty area) tak hi aisa kar sakta hai. yadyapi ismein kai pojeeshan (positions) hote hain jismein coach ke dvaara rananeeti ke anusaar unako vah pojeeshan milta hai kisi kaanoon[4] mein in pojeeshanon ka ullekh nahi hai aur na usaki aavashyakta hai.
buniyaadi upakaran ya keet (kit) ki jo aavashyakta hai usamein sharts, shorts, moje, joote aur pindali guard (shin guard) aadi ismein shaamil hai. buniyaadi upakaran mein sar guard (Headgear) ki aavashyakta nahi hai, lekin khilaadi apne sar ki chot se suraksha ke liye iska istemaal kar sakte hain khilaadi aisa kuchh pahanane ya istemaal karna varjit hain jisse khud ko ya anya khilaadi ke liye khatarnaak saabit ho jaise gahane ya ghadi gol keepar ko aise kapde pahanane chaahiye jisse anya khilaadiyon tatha adhikaareeyon dvaara aasaani se alag pahachaana jaana chaahiye.[20]
anek khilaadi khel ke beech mein sthaanaapann ke dvaara badle ja sakte hain. adhiktar antararaashtreeya pratiyogita aur gharelu league khelon mein adhiktam teen khilaadi ko badalne ki anumati praapt hai haalaaainki anya pratiyogitaaon ya dostaana maichon mein iski sankhya alag ho sakti hai. khilaadi ko badalne ke peechhe saamaanyat: kaaran chot, thakaan, yuddh kshamata kam ho jaana, ek takaneek, ya asamanjas khel ke ant mein samay ki vyarthata (timewasting) ke liye aadi hote hain. aadarsh vyask maichon mein jo khilaadi ek baar badal jaate hain ve match ka hissa nahi rahate hain.[21]
match ke liye jis referee (referee) ko niyukt kiya jaata hai us match mein uske paas khel ke niyamon ko laagu karne ka poorn adhikaar hota hai (niyam 5) aur usaka nirnaya antim hota hai. referee do sahaayak referee (assistant referee) ke dvaara sahaayata grahan karta hai. uchch stareeya khelon mein ek chautha adhikaari (fourth official) bhi hota hai jo referee ko sahaayata pradaan karta hai aur jarurat ke anusaar uske badle doosra adhikaari bhi aa sakta hai.[22]
pitch
jaisa ki niyam England mein bane the aur aarambh mein I ऍf ai bi (IFAB) ke bheetar chaaron british football asosiyeshan ne prashaasit kiya, football pitch ka ek aadarsh aayaam mool roop se shaahi unit (imperial units) mein vyakt kiya gaya. ab niyam ko anumaanit maap ke saath aayaamon ko abhivyakt kiya gaya (koshthak mein paaramparik ikaaiyon dvaara), haal ke maapiye (metrication) ka itihaas ke saath english bolne vaale deshon mein lokapriya ka prayog paaramparik ikaaiyon ko dhyaan mein rakhane ke liya kiya gaya jaise Britain.[23]
antararaashtreeya maichon ke liye peech ki lambaai 100-110&na meter ki shreni mein hai (110-120 yaard) aur chaudaai 64-75&n meter ki shreni mein hai (70-80 yaard) gair antararaashtreeya maichon ke liye 91-120 meter lambaai ho sakta hai (100-130yaard) aur chaudaai 45-91meetar (ho sakta hai agar peech ek varg nahi banta hai. sabse badi seema rekhaaen touch rekhaaen ya kinaare ki rekhaaen hain jabki chhoti seema (jahaaain se gol maara jaata hai)gol ki rekhaaen hain. aayataakaar gol pratyek gol rekha ke madhya par sthit hoti hai.[24] puri maidaan mein oordhvaadhar gol post ka bheetari kinaara 7.3 meter avashya hota hai (8 yaard) iske aalaava kshaitij krausabaar jo gol post dvaara samarthit hoti, ka nichla chhor 2.44 meter hona chaahiye.(8 feet) aam taur par jaal gol ke peechhe rakha jaata hai, lekin kaanoon ke anusaar usaki koi aavashyakta naheen hai.[25]
pratyek gol ke saamane ka kshetr penalty kshetr (penalty area) ke roop mein jaana jaata hai. yeh kshetr gol rekha ke dvaara chinhit rahati hai, do rekhaaen gol post se shuroo hoti aur jo gol post se 16.5 meter ki duri tak hoti hain (18 yaard) aur peech ki pankti or 16.5 meter badhati jaati hain aur rekha vahaaain milti hai. is kshetr ka anek kaarya hai, sabse pramukh kaarya yeh hai ki gol keepar geind ko kahaaain pakadta hai aur kahaaain bachaav dal ke sadasyon dvaara penalty faul hoti hai jisse penalty kick (penalty kick) ki saja milti hai. anya chinhein geind ke pojeeshan ya khilaadi ka kick maarane, gol kick, penalty kick aur kornor kick ko paribhaashit karti hain.[26]
avadhi aur taai ko todne ki vidhi
ek aadarsh football match 45 minit ka do avadhi ka hota hai jise haalv (aadha) kehte hain. pratyek aadha nirantar chalti rahati hai arthaat ghadi tab bhi naheen rookati jab geind khel se baahar chali jaati hai. saamaanyat: do aadha ke beech mein pandrah minit ka aadhe samay mein viraam hota hai match ka ant pura samay kahalaata hai.
referee match ka aadhikaarik samay ka dhyaan rakhane wala hota hai aur khilaadi ko badalate samay, khilaadi ko chot lagne ke kaaran khel ruk jaati hai ya anya thaharaav ke kaaran referee bhatta ke roop mein aur samay de sakta hai saamaanyat: joda gaya samay ko thaharaav samay ya chot samay kaha jaata hai aur yeh poorn roop se referee ke vivekaadhikaar par nirbhar hoti hai. referee ka ek sanket se match ka ant hota hai. jahaaain match mein chautha adhikaari hota hai, aadhe ke ant mein referee sanket deta hai ki thaharaav samay kitna jodna chaahiye. uske baad chautha adhikaari khilaadi aur darshakon ko pakade hue board se soochit karta hai. uske baad bhi referee us samay ko bada sakta hai.[27] atyadhik samay jodne ka kaarya 1891 mein ek match ke dauraan stok (Stoke) aur aston villa (Aston Villa) ke beech ek ghatna ki vajh se hui thi. match ka keval 1-0 minit baaki tha aur stok ko penalty mila tha. gol keepar villa geind ko maidaan ke baahar maar diya aur jab tak geind vaapas aati tab tak 90 minit samaapt ho gaye the aur khel samaapt ho gaya.[28]
league pratiyogitaaon mein khel ka samaapan dra ke saath ho sakta hai, lekin kuchh nok out pratiyogitaaon mein agar khel nirdhaarit samay tak taai raha to vah match atirikt samay tak chal sakta hai, jo pandrah minit ka do avadhi hota hai. agar score atirikt samay ke baad bhi taai rahata hai to kuchh pratiyogitaaon mein penalty shoot out (penalty shootouts) (adhikaarik roop mein khel ke niyam ke anusaar penalty chinh se kick maarana kaha jaata hai) ka prayog kiya jaata hai jismein jo team aage aaegi vah team pratiyogita ke agale charan mein jaayegi.atirikt samay ke dauraan jo gol ki jaati hai vah khel ka antim score hota hai lekin penalty chinh se jo kick maara jaata hai usaka prayog keval yeh nirnaya karne ke liye hota hai ki kaun si team pratiyogita ke agale charan mein jaayegi.(penalty shoot out ke dauraan jo gol score kiye jaate hain vah antim score ka hissa naheen hota).
do pairon ke pratiyogita mein (jismein pratyek team apne desh mein ek baar khelega) khel mein samaan score vaale banaane vaale teemon ke aage le jaane ke liye desh ke baahar ke gol wala niyam (away goals rule) ka prayog kar sakte hain aur vijeta vahi hota hai jo desh se baahar pair se khelne wala hota hai. yadi parinaam fir bhi baraabar ho to aam taur par penalty chinh se kick maarana aavashyak hai haalaaainki kuchh pratiyogitaaon mein taai hone se khel ko fir se khela jaana aavashyak hai.
1990s ke ant se 2000, ke shuruaat tak I ऍf ai bi (IFAB) ne penalty shoot out ki aavashyakta ke bina hi jeet haasil karne ki takareeb banaaye jo aksar avaanchhaneeya tareeke se match ka samaapan hona dekha gaya. ismein atirikt samay ke shuruaat mein hi khel ko samaapt kar dena shaamil hai, jab atirikt samay mein jab pehla gol score hota hai (svarn gol (golden goal)) ya yadi ek team atirikt samay ke ant tak score mein aage hota hai (silver/chaandi gol (silver goal)). svarn/golden gol ka prayog 1998 (1998) aur 2002 (2002) ke vishv cup mein hua tha. 1998. ke vishv cup mein golden/svarn gol ke dvaara pehla khel nirnaya paaraague (Paraguay) par France (France) ki vijay hui thi. Germany (Germany) pehla aisa raashtra tha jisne pramukh pratiyogita Euro 1996 (Euro 1996) mein chjech republeek (Czech Republic) ko final mein golden/svarn gol ke dvaara score karke haraaya tha.Euro 2004 (Euro 2004) mein silver/chaandi ka prayog hua tha. I ऍf ai bi[29] ke dvaara donon hi prayogon ko band kar diya gaya.
geind khel ke bheetar aur baahar
niyam ke tahat khel ke dauraan geind jab bheetar ho tab ka khel aur geind jab baahar ho tab ka khel yeh khel ke do buniyaadi tattv hain pratyek khel avadhi ke shuruaat kick maarane (kick-off) ke saath hoti hai (kendra se ek team ke dvaara kick ka jattha maarana) aur khel ke samay ke ant tak geind ke saath har samay khelte rahana hota hai jab tak geind maidaan ke baahar na chala jaae ya referee ke dvaara khel ko roka na jaae. jab geind khelne ke laayak nahi rahata tab khel aath ristaart vidhi ke ek vidhi ke dvaara khel fir se shuroo hoti hai jo kaise yeh khel laayak nahi hai par nirbhar karti hai.
lene hi wala hai
- geind maarana; virodhi team ke dvaara gol maarana ya pratyek avadhi ka khel shuroo karna. [2]
- andar feinkana (Throw-in); jab geind puri tarah se rekha paar kar jaati hai tab us virodhi team ko inaam milta jo geind antim baar chhoota hai.[30]
- gol kick (Goal kick); jab geind puri tarah gol rekha ko paar kar jaati hai gol ke bina hi score hota hai aur hamlaavar ke dvaara geind ko antim baar chhoone ke kaaran raksha karne waali team ko inaam milta hai.[31]
- kornor kick (Corner kick); jab geind bina gol ke hi gol rekha ko paar kar jaati hai aur raksha karne waali team ke dvaara geind ko antim baar chhoone ke kaaran hamlaavar team[32] ko inaam mein milta hai.
- apratyaksh muft kick (Indirect free kick); gair dand faul ke roop mein virodhi team ko inaam mein milti hai, jab kuchh takaneeki atilanghan ya pratidvandi ko bina kisi vishesh faul ke baahar bhej diya jaae aur khel ruk jaae. apratyaksh free kick se seedhe gol praapt naheen kiya ja sakta[33]
- pratyaksh muft kick (Direct free kick); beimaani karne ke kaaran soocheebaddh dand milti hai.[33]
- penalty kick (Penalty kick); baimaani karne ke kaaran pratyaksh muft kick milti hai lekin penalty kshetr mein beimaani karne ke kaaran virodhi team ko inaam ke roop mein penalty kick milti hai.[34]
- drop geind (Dropped-ball); jab referee kisi anya kaaran ke liye khel ko rok de jaise khilaadi ko gambhir chot lagne se, baahari party ke dvaara hastakshep ya geind ka khraab ho jaane ki vajah se yeh hota hai. vyask khelon mein fir se shuroo karna asaamaanya hai.[2]
beimaani aur durvyahaar
khel ke niyam mein yeh soocheebaddh hai ki faul (foul) tabhi hota hai jab khilaadi khelte samay koi aparaadh karta hai. faul/beimaani jo ek aparaadh hai kaanoon 12 mein soocheebaddh hai. jaan bujh kar geind ko haath se chhoona, pratidvandi ko pakad lena ya pratidvandi ko dhakka maarana ityaadi dand yogya faul hote hain aur faul kahaaain par hota hai uske aadhaar par pratyaksh muft kick (direct free kick) ya penalty kick (penalty kick) saja ke roop mein milti hai apratyaksh muft kick (indirect free kick) ke dvaara anya prakaar ke faul ki saja hoti hai.[1]
penalty kshetr ke bheetar aparaadh karne se
kick milti hai.
referee khilaadi ya kisi khilaadi ke badle mein aae khilaadi ko referee dand ke roop mein uske durvyavahaar (misconduct) ke liye (peela card (yellow card)) ya maidaan ke baahar bhej sakta hai (laal card (red card)) ek hi khel mein doosari baar peela card milne ka arth hai red/laal card ka milna aur uske baad maidaan se baahar.yadi ek khilaadi ko baahar nikaal diya jaata hai to uske sthaan mein koi doosra khilaadi nahi aa sakta hai. durvyavahaar kabhi bhi ho sakta hai aur jab aparaadhon mein durvyavahaar ka gathan hua hai aur soocheebaddh hai, iski paribhaasha bahut vyaapak hai. vishesh roop se "khraab vyavahaar" jaisa aparaadh adhiktar maichon mein dikhlaai deti hai jo khel ki bhaavana ka ullanghan karti hai, bhale hi ve vishisht aparaadh ke roop mein soocheebaddh nahi hai. kisi khilaadi, kisi khilaadi ke badle mein aae khilaadi ya vaikalpik khilaadi ke badle aae khilaadi ko referee yello/peela card ya red/laal card dikha sakta hai. gair khilaadi jaise prabandhak aur sahaayak karmachaari ko yello/peela ya red/laal card naheen dikhaaya ja sakta lekin yadi ve ek jimmedaar dhang se swayam ko sanchaalit karne mein asafal rahe to unhein takaneeki kshetr se nishkaasit kiya ja sakta hai.[1]
khel ko rokane ke bajaaye referee aparaadh karne vaale team ke virodhi team ko faayda de sakta hai tatha khel ko jaari rakh sakta hai."laabh ke saath khelna" ke roop mein yeh jaana jaata hai. referee vaapas khel mein bula sakta hai aur yadi pratyaashit laabh chhoti avadhi ke bheetar nahi hoti hai, to mool aparaadh ke liye dandit kar sakta hai aam taur par yeh chaar se paaainch second leti hai. yahaaain tak ki khelte samay faayda hone ki vajh se agar aparaadh ka dand sunishchit naheen ho paati lekin agale padaav tak durvyavahaar karne vaale khilaadi ko saja mil sakti hai.
of side (offside) ka kaanoon sabse jyaada jatil hai. of side niyam aage ke khilaadi geind ke bina doosra bachaav khilaadi ke aage nahi ja sakta (virodhi team ke gol rekha ke ekdam sameep) (jahaaain gol keepar ko bhi shaamil kar sakte hain)[35]

pramukh antar raashtreeya pratiyogita
FIFA dvaara aayojit vishv cup (World Cup) ek pramukh antararaashtreeya football pratiyogita hai. chaar saal mein ek baar is pratiyogita ka aayojan hota hai. 190 se bhi jyaada raashtreeya team arhat pratiyogita mein mahaadveepeeya sangh ke final mein sthaan paane ke liye bhaag lete hain chaar saal mein ek baar aayojit hone vaale is pratiyogita mein batees team bhaag leti hai aur yeh takreeban chaar saptaah tak chalti hai.[36]2006 ka FIFA vishv cup (2006 FIFA World Cup) Germany mein hua tha; 2010 ka vishv cup dakshin Africa (South Africa) mein huwa tha.[37]
los enjils (Los Angeles) ke 1932 ke khelon ko chhodkar 1900, se pratyek greeshmakaaleen olympik khel (Summer Olympic Games) mein football pratiyogita (football tournament) hoti haivishv cup se pehle olympic (vishesh kar ke 1920 dauraan) ki vishv cup mein yahi sthiti thi. mool roop se yeh khel avyavasaayi hai,[13] baharahaal, 1984 ke greeshmakaaleen olympic se (1984 Summer Olympics) peshevar khilaadiyon ko anumati di gayi, yadyapi kuchh pratibandhon ke baavajood majboot pakshon ke dvaara kshetr rakshan se apne deshon ki raksha vartamaan mein, 23 star ke neeche olympic puroosh pratiyogita/tournament khela gaya hai. pichhle olympic mein[38] pratyek team ke jyaada umr ke khilaadiyon ki sankhya seemit thi lekin 2008 ke olympic mein yeh pratha samaapt ho gayi. olympic pratiyogita ko aam taur par vishv cup ki tarah vahi pratishtha aur mahattv naheen diya jaata.1996; mein mahila pratiyogita ko sammilit kiya gaya; puroosh pratiyogitaaon ke vipreet bina aayu pratibndh ke poorn antararaashtreeya match mahila olympic tournament khela gaya. iske kaaran ise antararaashtreeya sammaan mila aur mahila vishv cup ki tulana FIFA se kiya gaya. (FIFA Women's World Cup)
vishv cup ke baad mahaadveepeeya pratiyogita sabse mahatvapoorn antararaashtreeya football pratiyogita hai, jiska aayojan pratyek mahaadveep sangh ke dvaara hota hai aur jismein raashtreeya teemon ke beech sangharsh/pratiyogita hoti hai. ye hain Europeeya championship (European Championship) (yu E ऍf ai) kopa America (Copa Améarica) (si O N em bi O L) raashtreeya afreekan cup (African Cup of Nations) (si ai ऍf), Asia cup (Asian Cup) (ai ऍf si), si O N si ai si ai ऍf gold cup (CONCACAF Gold Cup) (si O N si ai si ai ऍf) aur O ऍf si raashtreeya cup (OFC Nations Cup) (O ऍf si) club football ka sabse sammaanajanak pratiyogita mahaadveepeeya championship hai, jismein aam taur par raashtreeya championon ke beech pratiyogita hoti hai, udaaharan ke liye Europe mein yu E ऍf ai chainpiyans league (UEFA Champions League) aur dakshin America mein kopa librta dors the America (Copa Libertadores de Améarica). pratyek mahaadveepeeya pratiyogita ka vijeta FIFA club vishv cup (FIFA Club World Cup)[39] mein bhaag leta hai.
gharelu pratiyogita
pratyek desh ka gavarning nikaaya league pranaali (league system) sanchaalit karta hai saamaanya roop se iske kai prabhaag (division) hote hain jismein team ko pure kaal mein parinaam ke aadhaar par adhik ank milte hain. team dvaara praapt kiye ankon ke anusaar unako ek taalika (table) mein rakha jaata hai.round robin pratiyogita/tournament (round-robin tournament) mein saamaanyat: pratyek team anya sabhi teemon ke saath apne raajya tatha raajyon ke baahar pratyek mausam mein khelte hain. mausam ke ant mein sheersh team ko champion ghoshit kiya jaata hai. kuchh sheersh teemon ko ek uchch prabhaag mein bhej diya (promoted) jaata hai aur ek ya ek se adhik teemon ko neeche ke prabhaag mein ravaana (relegated) kar diya jaata hai. deshon ke league mein jo team sheersh par jaakar haar jaati hai nimnalikhit mausam mein antararaashtreeya club pratiyogita mein khelne ke yogya ho sakte hain ya khel sakte hain. laitin America (Latin America) ke league ke is pranaali mein kuchh mukhya apavaad hote hain, jo football championship ko do bhaagon mein vibhkt karta hai jiska naam hai apertura aur klausura (Apertura and Clausura) jismein pratyek champion ko sammaanit kiya jaata hai.
deshon ke bahumat se ek ya ek se adhik pratiyogita cup ke saath league pranaali ki poorti karta karta hai. inka aayojan dastak-baahar (knock-out) ke aadhaar par hota hai, tatha pratyek match ka vijeta agale round/daur mein jaata hai; aur haarne waali team pratiyogita mein fir bhaag naheen le sakti.
kuchh deshon mein ke sheersh prabhaag mein jyaada manhage star khilaadiyon ki suvidha rahati hai; chhote deshon aur nimn prabhaagon mein dviteeye shreni ke anshakaalik khilaadi ho sakte hain. yooropiyn league ke pauainch sheersh- seriyeya (Serie A) (Italy) la leega (La Liga) (Spain) premiyer league (Premier League) (England),[40] bandesliga (Bundesliga) (Germany) aur ligue (Ligue 1) (France)- vishv ke sabse aakarshit tatha sarvashreshth khilaadi hain.
is khel ka naam
1863, mein football asosiyeshan/sanstha dvaara England mein football ke niyamon ko suvyavasthit kiya gaya aur us samay football keanya roopon (other forms of football) vishesh kar ragbi football (rugby football) khela jaata tha iseeliye asosiyeshan football ko alag karne ke liye gadha gaya. sokkar shabd ka udbhav England mein hua, 1880s mein pehli baar "asosiyeshan" shabd ka gavaaainru roop dikhaai diya aur England ke kaptaan Charles reford-brovn (Charles Wreford-Brown) ko aksar iska shri diya jaata tha.[41]
aaj yeh khel jahaaain sabse lokapriya hai aamtaur par un deshon mein football code ke naam se jaana jaata hai jin deshon mein yeh alag code se lokapriya hai, saamaanyat: use sokkar kaha jaata hai aur vaastav mein sayunkt raashtra aur Canada ke gavarning nikaaya ka aadhikaarik naam hai FIFA vishv khel ka gavarning nikaaya ne paaribhaashit kiya hai ki apne vidhiyon[42] ke kaaran yeh asosiyeshan football hai, lekin FIFA aur antararaashtreeya olympic samiti (International Olympic Committee) ke dvaara football shabd ka prayog sabse adhik hua hai.

HIV/AIDS ka naam to aapne bhut jagha suna hoga ki ye koi bimari hoti hai jiska koi ilaj nahi hai. Iss Bimari ke liye logo ko jagruk karne ke liye World AIDS Day bhi manaya jata hai 1 December ko. chaliye jante hai hiv कैसे होता है or usse kaise nipta jaye.
Hiv Kya hota hai
hiv kaise hota hai
Agar kisi ko normal koi viral infection hota h to thodey dino baad thk ho jata h or Medicine ki madad se wo virus bhi mar jata hai, Par!!! Kisi ko hiv hua to uski body se ye virus kabhi nhi nikalta, wo insan hamesha ke liye hiv ka shikar ho jata h.
Hamari body k andar CD4 cell hotey h jinka kam hota h body ki help karna kisi bhi tarha k infection se ladne may, HIV inhi CD4 cells par attack karta h or hamarey immune system ko kamjor karta hai, HIV in CD4 cells ki sankhya ko kam kar deyta hai, jisey ki insan bar-barr bimar padne lagta h kuki jo cells infection sey ladne may madad kartey hai ab unki sankhya kam hoti jati h.
Abhi tak eysi koi si dawai nhi ban pai h jisey HIV sey hamesha k liye chutkara mil sakey. Par agar HIV infected person ko shai se treatment miley or uski sahi medical care ki jae to HIV or badney se roka ja sakta hai. HIV ko treat karne k liye jo Medicine use ki jati h unko antiretroviral therapy (ART) kaha jata h.
Agar Medicines roj sahi waqt par li jae to HIV ko or badney se roka ja sakta h, or wo insan bhi utni hi umar tak ji sakta h jitna ki ek normal insan jita h.
AIDS Ki Bimari Kaise Hoti Hai / HIV कैसे होता है
AIDS ka Matlb hota h Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome. Or AIDS, HIV ki last stage hoti h. Jaruri nhi h ki jisko HIV hai usko AIDS ho, jesa ki may pehley hi bata chuki hu ki agar sahi dekh bhal ki jae to HIV ko AIDS tak pohochne se roka ja sakta h.
AIDS ek eysi state hoti h jab body ka immune system buri tarha se damage ho chuka hota h, buri tarha se damage hone se ye matlb h ki, jo apka sharia h wo kisi bhi tarha k infection se ladne ki chamta kho chuka hota h, agar kisi ko AIDS h to wo itna kamjor ho chuka hota h ki normal sardi jukam se bhi nhi lad sakta. Wo insan itna kamjor ho jata h ki usko koi se bhi bimari asani sey ho sakti h.
Agar CD4 cells ki sankhya 200 cell per cubic millimeter of blood sey kam hoti h to ye mann liya jata h ki HIV ab AIDS ki taraf baad raha h (healthy person may iski sankhya 500 sey 1,600 cell per cubic millimeter hoti h). Agar kisi insan ko ek se jyada bimariy ya infection ek hi time par hone lagtey h or wo thk bhi nhi hotey to bhi ye battey AIDS ki taraf ishara karti h.
Yadi kisi ko AIDS h or uska treatment nhi ho raha h to wo Aids ka Marij bina treatment ke 3 sal tak ji sakta hai par agar uski halat jyada hi gambhir hai to wo bina treatment ke mushkil se ek sal hi ji paega.
HIV/AIDS Kaise Failta hai
HIV infected person se hath milane se ya macchar k katney ya infected person k cheekne sey Nhi feylta h
Ek or reson h jisey ki HIV ek person se dusrey tak feyl sakta h wo h ma sey bacchey ko, agar koi pregnant women h or wo HIV ka shikar h to chances h ki garbh may pal raha baccha bhi iska shikar ho jae, par aj kal development bohot ho gaya h eyse kai treatment agae h jisey ki bacchey ko HIV hone se bacchaya ja sakta h.

Aids kaise Pehchane/Diagnosis
Agar apko lagta h ki ap hiv se infected hai to isko conform karne ka ek hi tarika h or wo hai hiv test, ye test ap kisi bhi hospital may ya kisi sexual health clinic par ja k karwa saktey hai, or ye batey confidential rakhi jati h kisi ko nahi batai jati.
HIV test kab karaye, taki uska sahi result mile.. HIV ka pata karne ke liye 2 test hote hai, or iss test ko aap 4 Hafte baad kara sakte hai, or agar negative aaye to conform karne ke liye aap 3 mahine baad ek war or test kara sakte hai.. jisse aapko 100% sahi result mil jayega.
HIV testing may 2 test hotey pehla hota h prilimenary test jismey hiv ki antibodies detect ki jati h or second hota h confitne try test. Pehla hota h jismey apki fingures sey blood nikal jata h agar wo hiv se react kar jata h to second labouratey test kiya jata h jismey ye conform kiya jata h ki hiv positive h ya nhi. Agar negative ata h to koi dikkat hi nhi h ap safe h, par agar positive ata h to fir doctor apko treatments suggest kartey h.
HIV/AIDS ka ilaj (Treatment)
Hiv ka treatment HAARṬ ( higJuly active antiretrovial therapy) jo ki combination hota h anti hiv medicents ka. HAART se hiv ko khatam nhi kiya ja sakta h par ek haaḍ tak control kiya ja sakta h taki virus blood may or na feyley, or immune system strong bana rahe.
Ye Bohot jaruri hota h ki jo medicens apko doctor ne proscribe(likhi) ki hai wo ap shai time par ley. Agar ap doctor dwara priscribed kiye hue tarikey se Medicean nhi lengey ya sahi dose nhi lengey to ap utni jaldi recover nhi kar paengey, isey hiv or feylta jaega.
HIV/AIDS se kaise bachaye (Precaution)
Ye to ap jann hi gae h ki hiv ka koi permenent cure nhi h, isye bachne ka ek hi tarika h ki ap kuch bato ka dhyan rakhey jesi ki hamesha fresh needle (Nai sui) ka use karey, protected sex, multiple sex patner na ho.
