51 shakti pith mitu sahagal shakti pith bahut hi pavan tirth sthal mane jate hain. yahan desh-videsh ke kone-kone se bhakt shakti ki sadhna archana karne ate hain. shakti pith brahmand ke asim rahasyamyi shakti aur urja sthal hain jahan puja v tap karne ka vishesh mahatva hai. shakti puja yahan kai hajaron varshon se hoti ai hai. shakti pith tantrik siddhi prapti ke bhi mahatvapurn sthal hain. yahan vaidik v tantrik vidhiyon se puja hoti a rahi hai. siddhi aur moksh prapti ke lie sadhak yahan khinche chale ate hain. aisa mana jata hai ki jahan shakti pith sthapit hain, ve sthal brahmand ki urja ke asim bhandar hain. atah guru diksha aur shakti pat ke lie ye sthal uttam hain. pauranik mat ke anusar, satya yug men dakshaprajapti ne yagya ka aranbh kiya jismen shivji ko amantrit nahin kiya. pita ke ghar mahasmaroh se yagya ho raha hai, yah sunakar sati ne nimantran n pane par bhi yagya men jana chaha. shivji ne pahle to mana kiya par sati ke agrah par unhen anuchron ke sath jane ki agya de di. vahan jane par daksh dvara shiv ka apman dekh sati ne usi yagya ki agni men atmadah kar liya.
shivji ne yah vrittant sunte hi daksh ke ghar jakar yagya vidhvans kar diya aur sati ka shav uthakar tandav karne lage. yah dekh vishnu ne vivash hokar sudarshan chakra se sati ke ang-pratyang kat dale. sati ka sharir 51 khandon men vibhakt hua aur jahan unke vibhinn ang gire us sthan par shakti pith sthapit kiye gae jo hinduon ke pramukh tirth sthal mane jate hain. ye shakti pith bharat, pakistan, shri lanka aur bangladesh men pae jate hain. 51 shakti pith is prakar hain- hingula : devi ka brahmarandhra yahan gira. yahan devi kottavish aur shiv bhimlochan ke nam se sthapit hain. yah pith karachi ke nikat dakshini pakistan men ek gufa men sthit hai. gufa ke andhere men roshni ki kiran puja sthal ko prakashman karti hai. sharkara (kolhapur) : maharashtra ke kolhapur shahar men sthit is pith men devi ke tin chakshu gire.
shiv-shakti yahan krodhish aur mahshimardini ke rup men sthapit hain. mahalakshmi ka prasiddh mandir bhi yahin par hai. sugandha : sungdha men devi ki nasika giri thi. yahan shiv-shakti tryanbak aur sunanda ke rup men sthapit hain. shiv-chaturdashi ke din bhakt yahan bari sankhya men ate hain. yah pith dakshini bangladesh men hai. amrnath : kashmir men sthit mukhay tirth sthan amrnath men devi ka kanthdesh gira. yahan shiv-shakti trisandhyeshvar aur mahamaya ke rup men sthapit hain. har varsh barf ka shivling banta hai jiske darshan karne ke lie bhakt dur-dur se ate hain. jvalamukhi : jvalamukhi kangra, himachal pradesh men sthit hai. yahan devi ki mahajihva giri aur shiv-shakti yahan unmat aur siddhida bhairav ke rup men sthapit hain. jvalamukhi ka mandir adbhut shakti ka sthal hai. jalandhar : yahan devi ka stan gira tha aur shiv-shakti yahan bhishan aur jay tripurmalini ke rup men jane jate hain. vaidyanath : devi ka hriday yahan gira tha. shiv-shakti yahan vaidyanath aur jaydurga ke rup men avasthit hain. yah bharat ke 12 jyotirlingon men se ek hai. pashuptinath : pashuptinath nepal men sthit shaktipith hai jahan devi ka janu ya ghutna gira tha. yahan shiv-shakti kapali aur mahamaya ke nam se avasthit hain. yah nepal ka bahut hi prasiddh tirth sthal hai. manas : manas tibbat men sthit bahut hi prachin, vikhyat aur shaktishali pith hai jahan shiv-shakti amar aur dakshayni ke rup men sthapit hain.

Aaj kal looks hee sab kuch hai. Social circles me ya to professional circles, dikhava agar sahi nahin ho to voh vyakti avkarya nahin hai. Shayad isi karan se khas kar ke mahilao me aur aaj kal purusho me bhi beauty creams ka upyog badhta jaa raha hai. Fairness creams, face glow creams, sunscreen creams, anti-ageing creams aur aise alag prakar ke creams ka khulle hath upyog hota hai. In beauty creams me kai aise chemicals hai jo short term me jaroor fayda dikhati hai magar lambe samay par nuksan pahuncha kar tvacha ko bilkul bejan aur jhurri yukt bana deti hai.
Shampoo, Nail polish, Perfumes, Lotions ke Nuksan
In sabhi samagri me dibutyl phthalate, dimethyl phthalate aur diethyl phthalate hote hai. Harvard School of Public Health ne study kiya aur yeh paya gaya hai ki phthalate se purusho me shukranu ko hani hota hai. Phthalate se genetic modification ho sakta hai aur garbhvati mahilao ko sambhal ke rehna chahiye in sabhi saundarya prasadhano se.
Fairness Creams Kare Nuksan
Tvacha gora ho yeh sabhi ki khwaish hai aur purush aur mahila khul ke fairness creams ka upyog karte hai. In fairness creams me hota hai steroids, tretinoin aur hydroquinone. Yeh chemicals dwara liver ko nuksan hota hai. Mercury based compounds ho to yeh atyant zehreele hote hai. Skin cancer hona sambhav hai aur dag dhabbe ho jaate hai jinhe mitana bahut mushkil sabit hota hai. In creams me hote hai BHA aur BHT jo cancer ke karan hai aur yeh thyroid aur sex organs ko bhi hani pahunchata hai. Hydroquinone short term me chehra bleach karta hai magar lambe samay par kale dhabbe ho jate hai tvacha par aur tvacha rukhu aur bejan ho jaati hai.
Sodium Borate aur Boric Acid
Yeh baby ke diaper creams me paya jaata hai aur anya face creams me bhi. In chemicals ka asar hormone system par hota hai jis se purusho me banjhpan aa sakta hai.
Coal Tar Based Products
Hair dye aur psoriasis tatha dandruff treatment shampoo aur hair dyes me upyog hota hai phenlylenediamine, diaminobenze aur aminophenol. In chemicals ke upyog se cancer hone ki puru sambhavna hai.
Preservatives ke Nuksan
Har ek prakar ke creams aur beauty products me preservatives hote hai jaise DMDM hydantoin, diazolidinyl urea, methenamine aur imidazolidinyl urea jo formaldehyde ka utapadan karte hai aur yeh chemical seedha brain par asar karta hai.
Sunscreen
Sunscreens me oxybenzone paya jata hai jis ka karya hai UV kirano ko absorb karna. Magar yehi chemical irritation paida karta hai, allergy paida karta hai aur hormone ke karya me badharup ban ke khada ho jaata hai. Sunscreen aur anya lip creams me Retinol bhi ho sakta hai jin ke karan skin cancer ho sakta hai.
Toothpaste, Deo, Hand Sanitizers
Hand sanitizers ka khoob prachar hota hai aur deo ka bhi. In sabhi me hota hai triclosan. Triclosan thyroid granthi par aur sex organs par hanikarak asar karta hai to bach ke rahe.
Hair Spray aur Beauty Creams
Balo ko lachila aur silky smooth banane ke liye aur tvacha ke liye jo spray aur cream hai un me methicone chemical upyog kiya jaata hai jo siloxane group ka hai. In se hormones ke karya me badha khadi ho jaati hai aur kam shakti aur fertility par asar hota hai.
Anti-Aging Creams
Anti-aging creams me hote hai TEA, DEA aur MEA chemicals jo liver aur kidney ko nuksan karte hai aur cancer ke karanrup hote hai.
Makeup Saundarya Prasadhan
Mascara, foundation, lotion, serum aur creams me dozen se jyada chemicals hote hai. Khas kar ke petroleum based chemicals bahut nuksan dayak hai. Tvacha dwara yeh absorb ho ke khoon me chale jate hai aur sabhi granthi par asar hota hai. Yeh sabhi saundarya prasadhano se pimples aur acne ki samasya badh jaati hai. Skin cancer ka khatra khada ho jaata hai. Lead yane shisha ho to is se cancer hota hai, brain ka kamkaj par asar hota hai, fertility par jhatka lagta hai aur high blood pressure ho jaata hai. Heavy make up karne se sar me dard, chakkar aana, ulti hona aur adhik thakan mehsoos hona aam baat hai.
Cleansers
Moisturizers aur cleansers ka upyog to jaise compulsory ho gaya hai. Peeling masks bhi bahut popular hai. In sabhi me aise chemicals hote hai jo tvacha ka natural pH balance ko disturb kar dete hai. Vitamin C aur retinoid jyada praman me ho to yeh atyant acidic padarth se tvacha ka prakrutik rakshan UV kirano ke samne jo hai voh disturb ho jaata hai. Kai prasadhano me jyada alkaline padarth hote hai jo pH level ko dusturb kar dete hai. Tvacha rukhi ho jaati hai aur jaldi se jhurriya pad jaati hai.
To yeh sab ka ilaj kya? Beauty products ka alternative kya hai? World ke top brands ke formulations me bhi nuksaran rasayan hote hai. Far east ke saste products to muft me bhi na le, pachtaoge.
Ek rasta yeh hai ki sirf organic aur herbal products ka hee upyog kare. Hamesha label padhe aur dekhe ki is me ingredients kaunse hai. Parabens, glycol, retinoids, preservatives aur anya chemicals ho to aise products na khareede. Doosra tarika yeh hai ki ghar par hee natural products ke upyog se banaye beauty products aur gharelu upchar aur gharelu nuskhe apnaye beauty aur skin care ke liye. Ho sake itna kam make up ka upyog kare aur prakrutik samagri ka upyog kare to saundarya me aur dikhav me kuch kami nahin hogi aur tvacha ko nuksan bhi nahin.

bhaarateeya aaryabhaasha ke madhyayug mein jo anek praadeshik bhaashaaeain viksit hui unka saamaanya naam praakrut hai aur un bhaashaaon mein jo granth rache gaye un sabko samuchchaya roop se praakrut saahitya kaha jaata hai. vikaas ki drushti se bhaashaavaijnyaaanikon ne Bhaarat mein aaryabhaasha ke teen star niyat kiye hain - praacheen, madhyakaaleen aur arvaacheen. praacheen star ki bhaashaaeain vaidik sanskrut aur sanskrut hain, jinke vikaas ka kaal anumaanat: E. poo. 2000 se E. poo. 600 tak maana jaata hai. madhyayugeen bhaashaaeain hain - maagadhi, ardhamaagadhi, shauraseni, paishaachi bhaasha, mahaaraashtri aur apabhransh. inka vikaasakaal E. poorv 600 E. 1000 tak paaya jaata hai. iske pashchaat, hindi, gujaraati, maraathi, baingala, aadi uttar Bhaarat ki aadhunik aaryabhaashaaon ka vikaas praarambh hua jo aaj tak chala aa raha hai.

praakrut ki utpatti ke vibhinn siddhaant
ab prashn yeh hota hai ki madhyayug ki bhaashaaon mein sanskrut ki apeksha itni adhik visheshataaeain kab, kyon, kaise aur kahaaain par utpann ho gain. praakrut ke vararuchi aadi vaiyaakaranon ne praakrut bhaashaaon ki prakruti sanskrut ko maankar usase praakrut shabd ki vyutpatti ki hai. "prakruti: sanskrutan, tatrabhavan tat aagatan va praakrutam". kintu sanskrut bhaasha ka vartamaan svaroop swayam E. poorv chhathi shati ke lagbhag viksit hua hai aur use sthir roop to paanini dvaara E. poo. teesari chauthi shati mein diya gaya hai. sanskrut ke ukt prakaar ke anek lakshanon se vibhinn bhaashaaon ka chhathi shati E. poo. mein hi utpann hona kaise sambhav ho sakta hai ? iske atirikt praakrut mein aise bhi anek shabd paae jaate hain jinka sanskrut mein abhaav hai, kintu vaidik bhaasha mein ve vidyamaan hain. praakrut ki anek pravruttiyon ko liye hue bahut se shabd vedon mein paae jaate hain, jo sanskrut vyaakaran ke anukool naheen hain. is samasya par anek paashchaatya vidvaanon ka ek mat yeh hai ki aaryabhaasha jab bhaaratavarsh mein prachalit hui, anaarya log usaka aaryo ke sadrush shuddh shuddh uchchaaran aur prayog naheen kar paae; ataev unhonne apne niji uchchaaran evam bhaashaashaili ke anusaar use bolna praarambh kiya aur unke sampark se is ka prabhaav aaryo par bhi pada. isi ke falasvaroop praakrut bhaasha ki pravruttiyon ka vikaas hua. is mat ke samarthan mein yeh baat bhi dhyaan dene yogya hai ki vaidik kaal se hi jo t th aadi moordhanya dhvaniyon ka pravesh aaryabhaasha mein hua, vah bahulata se us kaal ki anaarya bhaashaaon ka hi prabhaav tha. kintu praacheen anaarya bhaashaaon ka vishleshan kar yeh siddh naheen kiya ja sakta ki praakrut ki ukt visheshataaon ka beej un anaarya bhaashaaon mein vidyamaan the. iseeliye is mat ke sambandh mein vivaad hai.
doosra mat yeh hai ki vedon ki bhaasha bolanevaale jaatiyon mein hi swayam dhvanyaatmak bhed the, jinke kuchh pramaan vedon mein hi upasthit hai anumaanat: vedon ki bhaasha us kaal ki roodhibddh vedabhaasha ke kramavik se anumaanat: kai hajaar varsho mein sanskrut bhaasha ka vikaas hua, par visheshat: sushikshit purohit varg ki apni bhaasha thi, tatha jismein dhaarmik kaaryon me hi upayog kiya jaata tha. utane hi kaal praacheenatam vaidik bhaasha ki samakaaleen janasaadhaaran ki lokabhaasha se sanskrut ke saath saath hi praakrut ka bhi vikaas hua, jismein pradeshabhedaanusaar naana tab praakrut ke vaiyaakaranon ne sanskrut ko praakrut ki prakruti kyon kaha? iska kaaran un vyaakaranon ke rache jaane ke kaal aur unke svaroop par dhyaan dene se spashtat: samajh me aa jaata hai. ve vyaakaran us kaal mein likhe gaye jab vidvatsamaaj mein praakrut ki apeksha sanskrut ka adhik prachaar aur sammaan tha. ve likhe bhi sanskrut bhaasha mein gaye hain tatha unka uddeshya bhi sanskrut naatakon mein bhi praakrutikta rakhane ke liye karna padta tha aur jinmein utkrusht saahityik rachanaaeain bhi nirmit ho chuki theen. ataev un vaiyaakaranon ne sanskrut ko aadarsh thaharaakar usase jo visheshataaeain praakrut mein theen unka vivran upasthit kar diya aur iski saarthakata sanskrut ko praakrut ki prakruti kehkar siddh kar di. tathaapi namisaadhu ne apna yeh mat spasht prakat kiya hai ki prakruti ka arth lok ya janta hai aur janasaadhaaran ko bhaasha hone se hi vah praakrut kahalaai. prakruti ka arth lok bahut praacheen hai tatha kaalidaas ne bhi usaka lok ke arth mein prayog kiya hai (raaja prakruti ranyajanaat, raghu. sarg, 4). praakruton ki is ati praacheen parampara ke prakaash mein in bhaashaaon ko vaidik aur sanskrut ki apeksha uttarakaaleen va madhyayugeen kehne ka auchitya bhi vichaaraneeya ho jaata hai. usaki yadi koi saarthakata hai to keval itni ki ye bhaashaaeain vaidik aur sanskrut ke pashchaat hi saahitya mein prayukt huin. unka pratham baar dhaarmik prachaar ke liye upayog E. poo. chhathi shati me shraman mahaaveer aur buddh ne kiya. tatha unki saahityik rachanaaon mein shabdon tatha shaili ki drushti se sanskrut ka bada prabhaav drushtigochar hota hai.

bhaasha jab tak boli ke roop mein rahati hai, usamein desh aur kaal ki apeksha nirantar parivartan hote rahate hain. isi niyam ke anusaar kaal ke saapeksh praakrut ke teen star sveekaar kiye gaye hain -
- poorvakaaleen (E. poo. 600 se 100 E. tak),
- madhyakaaleen (E. 100 se 600 E. s. tak) tatha
- uttarakaaleen (E. san 600 se 1000 tak).
praacheen star ki praakrut
shraman mahaaveer aur buddh ne jis bhaasha ya bhaashaaon mein apne upadesh diye ve praakrut ke praacheen star ke utkrusht roop rahe honge. unke upadeshon ki bhaasha ko kramash: maagadhi evam ardhamaagadhi kaha gaya hai. kintu vartamaan mein paali kahi jaanevaali bhaasha ke granthon mein hame maagadhi ka vah svaroop naheen milta jaisa pashchaatkaaleen vaiyaakaranon ne batalaaya hai. tathaapi bhaasha ka jo svaroop bauddh tripitk granthon mein paaya jaata hai vah praakrut ke praacheen star ka hi sveekaar kiya jaata hai. is star praakrut ka sarvat: praamaanik svaroop ashok ki shilaaon aur stanbho par utkeern dharmalipiyon mein upalabadh hota hai. in shilaaon ki sankhya lagbhag 30 hai. saubhaagya se inmein keval E. poorv truteeya shati ki praakrut bhaasha ka svaroop surakshit hai, kintu un prashastiyon mein tatkaaleen bhaasha ke praadeshik bhed bhi hamein praapt hote hain. pashchimottar pradesh mein shahabaajagadhi aur maanasehara naamak sthaanon ki shilaaon par jo 14 prashastiyaaain khudi hui pai gayi hain unamein sparsh varnon ke atirikt r aur l evam sh sh s ye teenon ooshm praaya: apne apne sthaanon par surakshit hain. rakaar yukt sanyukt varn bhi dikhaai dete hain. kintu jnya aur naya ke sthaan par nyanya ka prayog paaya jaata hai. is prakaar yeh bhaasha vaiyaakaranon ki paishaachi praakrut ka poorvaroop kahi ja sakti hai. ye hi 14 prashastiyaaain us bhaasha ko shauraseni ka praacheen roop prakat karti hain. uttar pradeshavarti kaalasi, jaugad nachhauli naamak sthaanon par bhi ve hi 14 prashastiyaaain utkeern hain. inmein hamein r ke sthaan par l tatha akaaraant sanjnyaaaon ke karta kaarak ek vachan ki A vibhkti praapt hoti hai. tathaapi teenon ooshmon ke sthaan par sh naheen kintu s ka astitv milta hai. is prakaar yahaaain maagadhi praakrut ke teen lakshan naheen. ataev ise maagadhi ki apeksha ardhamaagadhi praakrut ke teen lakshanon mein se do prachur roop se praapt hote hain, kintu sakaar sambandhi teesara lakshan naheen. ataev ise maagadhi ki apeksha ardhamaagadhi praakrut ka praacheen roop kehna adhik upayukt prateet hota hai. ashok ki prashastiyaaain unke bhaashaatmak mahatva ke atirikt saahityik drushti se bhi mahatvapoorn hain. unamein praacheen Bhaarat (E. poo. 3ri shati) ke ek aise samraat ke neeti, dharm evam sadaachaar sambandhi vichaar aur upadesh nihit hain jisne na keval is vishaal desh ke samast bhaagon par raajaneetik adhikaar hi praapt kiya tha, tatha desh ke baahar bhi alekjeindriya tak bhinn bhinn deshon se saanskrutik sambandh sthaapit kiya tha aur yahaaain apne dharmadoot bhi bheje the. is sabke baahar bhi alekjeindriya tak bhinn bhinn deshon se saanskrutik sambandh sthaapit kiya tha aur vahaaain apne dharmadoot bhi bheje the. in sab drushtiyon se yeh saahitya apne dhang ka adviteeya hai.
praacheen star ki praakrut ka doosra udaaharan udeesa ki udayagiri khandagiri ki haatheegunfa naamak guha mein utkeern kalingasamraat khaaravel ka lekh hai jo anek baaton mein ashok ke shilaalekhon se samata rakhata hai. kintu iski apni visheshata yeh hai ki ismein us samraat ke varsho ki vijyon tatha lokakalyaan sambandhi kaaryo ka vivran likha gaya hai. iska kaal anumaanat: E. poo. dviteeya shati hai. usaki bhaasha ashok ki girnaar ki prashastiyon se mel khaati hai, ataev vah praacheen shauraseni kahi ja sakti hai. is praakrut ka E. poo. teesari shataabdi man pashchim Bhaarat aur uske sau, dedh sau varsh pashchaat jain shatkhandaagam aadi granthon evam kundakundaachaarya aadi ki dakshin pradesh ki rachanaaon mein paaya jaana usaki tatkaaleen digvijya tatha saarvabhaumikta ka pramaan hai. us kaal mein itna prachaar aur kisi bhaasha ka naheen paaya jaata.
isi praacheen star ki praakrut ka prayog hamein ashvaghosh krut saariputr prakaran aadi naatakon ke upalabdh khandon mein praapt hota hai. inmein naayakon tatha ek do anya paatron ko chhodkar shesh sabhi paatr praakrut bolte hain, jiske teen roop spasht dikhaai dete hain. saariputr prakaran mein dusht ki bhaasha mein r ke sthaan par l, teenon ooshmon ke sthaan par sh tatha akaaraant sanjnyaaaon ke kartaakaarak ekavachan ke roop mein A vibhkti, ye teen lakshan spashtat: us bhaag ko maagadhi siddh karte hain. yahaaain k t aadi aghosh varn na to g d aadi saghoshon mein parivrtit hue milte, na th gh aadi mahaapraan varn h mein parivrtit hue milte, na th gh aadi mahaapraan varn hru mein parivrtit hue aur na dantya n ke sthaan par moordhanya n dikhaai deta. ye ashvaghosh ki praakrut ke lakshan use praacheen star ki siddh kar rahe hain. gorv naamak paatr ki bhaasha ki praakrut mein r ke sthaan par s ka prayog hua hai. ye lakshan use ardhamaagadhi siddh kar rahe hain. naayika, vidooshak tatha anya paatron ki praakrut mein r aur l apne apne sthaanon par hain. sab ooshm s ke roopamein paae jaate hain tatha kartaakaarak ekavachan okaaraant paaya jaata hai. inse yeh bhaasha spashtat: praacheen shauraseni kahi ja sakti hai.
dviteeya star ki praakrut
iske pashchaat praakrut bhaashaaon ke jo bhed prabhed hue unka vishd varnan bharat naatyashaastr (adhyaaya 17) mein praapt hota hai. unhonne vaani ka paath do prakaar ka maana hai- sanskrut aur praakrut; tatha kaha hai ki praakrut mein teen prakaar ke shabd prachalit hain- samaan (tatsam), vibhrasht (tadbhav) aur deshi. naatak mein bhaashaaprayog ka vivran unhonne is prakaar diya hai - uttam paatr sanskrut bolein, kintu yadi ve daridr ho jaaeain to praakrut bolein; shraman, tapasvi bhikshu, stri, baalak, aadi ashuddh hai. tathaapi itna spasht hai ki unhonne k, t, the, ya aur va ke lop, kh, gh aadi mahaapraan varno ke sthaan par h ka aadesh; t ka d, anaadi t ka aspasht the car uchchaaran; sht, shn aadi ka khakaar, in parivrtanon ka ullekh kiya hai. isse pramaanit hai ki ve dviteeya star ki praakrut ka hi varnan kar rahe hain. 32vein adhyaaya mein unhonne dhruva naamak geetikaavya ka vistaar se udaaharanon sahit varnan kiya hai aur spasht kaha hai ki dhruva mein shauraseni ka hi prayog kiya jaana chaahiye (bhaasha tu shoraseni dhruvaayaaain sanprayojayet). yeh baat unke udaaharanon se bhi pramaanit hai. at: pashchaatkaaleen dhaarana nirmool hai ki naatakon ke geya bhaag mein mahaaraashtri ka prayog kiya jaaya. bharat ke mat se naatak mein shauraseni bhaasha ka prayog kiya jaaya ya ichhaanusaar kisi bhi deshabhaasha ka. aisi deshabhaashaaeain saat hain - maagadhi, aavanti, shauraseni, ardhamaagadhi, vaahleeka aur dakshinaatya. ant:pur nivaasiyon ke liye maagadhi; chet, raajaputr aur sethon ke liye arghamaagadhi; vidooshakaadi ke liye praachya; naayika evam sakhiyon ke liye ardhamaagaghi; vidooshakaadi ke liye praachya; naayika evam sakhiyon ke liye shauraseni se aviruddh aavanti; yoddha, naagrik tatha juaariyon ke liye daakshinaatya; tatha udeechya, khas, shabar, shak aadi jaatiyon ke liye vaahleeka ka prayog karein. inke atirikt bharat ne shabar, aabheer, chaandaal aadi ki heen bhaashaaon ko vibhaasha kaha hai. is prakaar bharat ke naatak ke paatron mein jo praakrut bhaavanaaon ka baintavaara kiya hai usaka sanskrut ke naatakon mein aanshik roop se hi paalan kiya jaata hai.
sanskrut naatakon mein sabse adhik praakrut ka upayog aur vaichitrya shoodrak krut mruchhakatikm mein milta hai. pishl, keeth vidvaanon aadi ke mataanusaar to mruchhakatik ki rachana ka uddeshya hi praakrut sambandhi naatyashaastr ke niyamon ko udaahrut karna prateet hota hai. is naatak ke teekaakaar pruthveedhar ke mataanusaar naatak mein chaar prakaar ki praakrut ka hi prayog kiya jaata hai - shauraseni, avantika, praachya aur maagadhi. prastut naatak mein sootradhaar, nati, naayika vasantasena, chaarudatt ki braahmani stri evam shreshthi tatha inke parichaarak parichaarikaaain aise 11 paatr shauraseni bolte hain. aavanti bhaasha bolanevaale keval do apradhaan paatr hain. praachya bhaasha keval vidooshak bolata hai; tab kunj, chetak, bhikshu aur chaarudatt ka putr kul chhah paatr maagadhi bolte hain inke atirikt shakaari, chaandaali tatha dhakki ke bhi bolanevaale ek ek do do paatr hain. kintu yadi in sab paatron ki bhaasha ka vishleshan kiya jaae to ve sab keval do bhaagon mein baaainti ja sakti hain - shauraseni aur maagaghi. teekaakaar ne swayam kaha hai ki aavanti mein keval rakaar va lokoktiyon ka baahulya hota hai aur praachya mein svaarthik kakaar ka. anya baaton mein ve shauraseni hi hain. shakaari, chaandaali tatha dhakki sab maagadhi ki hi shailiyaaain hai. is prakaar naamachaar ka praakrut baahulya hone par bhi vastut: mruchhakatik mein ashvaghosh ke naatakon ki apeksha koi adhik bhaashaabhed naheen dikhaai deta. praakrut ka svaroop kaalagati se vishesh viksit ho gaya hai aur usamein kuchh aise lakshan aa gaye hain jinke kaaran is praakrut ko praacheen star ki apeksha dviteeya star ki kaha jaata hai. isi star ki praakrut tatha uske deshabhedon ka vivran hamein upalabdh praakrut vyaakaranon mein milta hai aur unheen ka vipul saahitya bhi vidyamaan hai.
dviteeya star ki praakrut ka sarvapraacheen vyaakaran chandakrut praakrut lakshan ya aarsh praakrut vyaakaran hai. yeh ati sankshipt hai aur keval 99 sootron mein praakrut ki vidhiyon ka niroopan kar diya gaya hai. is star ki visheshata batalaane vaale sootr dhyaan dene yogya hain. sootr 76 ke anusaar vargo ke pratham k ch t t aadi varnon ke sthaan par truteeya ka aadesh hota hai, jaise, pishaachi -- bisaaji, jata -- data, krutan -- kadan, pratisiddh -- padisiddhan. sootr 77 ke anusaar kh gh ch aur bh ke sthaan mein hakaar ka aadesh jaise- mukhan -- muhan, megh: -- neho, maadhav: -- maahavo, vrushabh: -- vasaho. sootr 97 ke anusaar k tatha vargon ke truteeya varno (g j aadi) ka svar ke pare lop hota hai, jaise - kokil: -- Kohli, bhaugik: -- bhoio, raaja -- raaya, nadi -- nai. sootr 98 ke anusaar lupt vyanjan ke pare a hone par ya hota hai, jaise - kaakaaoo kaayaaoo, naanaaoo naaya, raajaaoo raaya. antim 99vein sootr mein kaha gaya hai ki praakrut ki shesh vyavastha shisht prayogon se jaanani chaahiye. inse aage ke chaar sootron mein apabhransh ka lakshan, sanyukt varn se lakaar ka lop na hona, peshaachi ka r aur n ke sthaan par l aur na ka aadesh, maagadhika ka r aur s ke sthaan par l aur sh ka aadesh, tatha shauraseni ka t ke sthaan mein vikalp se d ka aadesh batalaaya gaya hai. bhaashaashaastriyon ka mat hai ki dviteeya star ke aadi me k aadi abodh varnon ke sthaan par g aadi saghosh varno ka uchchaaran hone laga. fir inki alpatar dhvani shesh rahi aur fir sarvatha lop ho gaya, tatha mahaapraan dhvaniyon ke sthaan par keval ek shuddh ooshm dhvani h avashisht rah gayi. ye pravruttiyaaain tatha ukt aarsh vyaakaran mein nirdisht ya shruti vikalp se samast jain praakrut hai. kintu pashchaatkaaleen 16veen, 17veen shati ke praakrut vaiyaakaranon ne praakruton ke niroopan mein jo bhraantiyaaain utpann ki hain, unke aadhaar par kuchh paashchaatya vidvaanon ne jain saahitya ki praakruton ko ukt vikalpon ke sadbhaav ke kaaran jain shauraseni tatha jain mahaaraashtri naamon dvaara pruthak nirdisht karna aavashyak samjha, yeh aitihaasik drushti se vaastavik naheen hai.
is aarsh praakrut vyaakaran ke pashchaat praakrutaprakaash naamak vyaakaran likha gaya, jismein aage do baar vruddhi ki gayi. aadi ke nau parichhed vararuchi krut hain. iname aadarsh praakrut ki kramash: svaravidhi, vyanjanavidhi, sanyuktavarn vidhi, sankeern, sanjnyaaaroop, sarvanaam vidhi, kriyaaroop, dhaatvaadesh evam avyayon ka niroopan kiya gaya hai. ant mein kaha gaya hai ki praakrut ka shesh svaroop sanskrut ke samajhna chaahiye. is vyaakaran mein dviteeya star ke praakrut ka svaroop poornaroop se nirdhaarit hua paaya jaata hai. iske anusaar madhyavarti k g ch j t d p ya aur the ka praaya: lop hota hai, evam kh gh th dh aur bh ke sthaan par h aadesh. praakrutaprakaash ke is praacheen vibhaag par kaatyaayan, bhaamah, vasantaraaj, sadaanand aur raamapaanivaadakrut teekaaeain pai jaati hain. aage ke 10vein aur 12vein parichhedon mein kramash: paishaachi ka 14 sootron mein tatha maagadhi ka 17 sootron mein niroopan kiya gaya hai. in donon bhaashaaon ki prakruti shauraseni kahi gayi hai. kintu isse poorv kaheen bhi shaureseni ka naam naheen aaya. ataev anumaanat: iske kartaaon ki drushti mein saamaanya praakrut ka niroopan us kaal ki suprachalit shoraseni ka hi hai. in do parichhedon par keval bhaamah ki teeka hai aur vidvaanon ka anumaan hai ki ye donon parichhed unheen ke jode hue hain. inmein paishaachi ka visheshata shabd ke madhya mein truteeya chaturth varno ke sthaan par pratham tatha dviteeya ka aadesh, n ke sthaan par n, jnya, nya ke sthaan par nyanya tatha tva ke sthaan par toon batalaai gayi hai aur maagadhi ki sh, s, ke sthaan par ksh j ke sthaan par y, ksh ke sthaan par ek ahan ke sthaan par hake, hage va ahake, tatha akaaraant karta kaarak ekavachan ke ant mein A kahi gayi hain. praakrut prakaash ka antim 12 vaaain parichhed bahut peechhe joda gaya prateet hota hai. ispar bhaamah va anya kisi ki teeka naheen hai. is parichhed ki avastha badi vilkshan hai. ismein shauraseni ke lakshan batalaae gaye hain, jiski aadi mein hi prakruti sanskrut kahi gayi hain. kintu antim 32vein sootr mein pun: kaha gaya haihru sheshan mahaaraashtri vat. parantu mahaaraashtri shabd isse poorv granth bhar mein athva anya kaheen vyaakaran mein aaya hi naheen hai. jaan padta hai yeh parichhed us samay joda gaya hai jab yeh dhaarana sudrudh ho gayi ki praakrut kaavya ki bhaasha mahaaraashtri hi honi chaahiye. ataev jahaaain praakrut ka nirdesh hai, vahaaain mahaaraashtri ka hi taatparya grahan kiya jaaya. yahaaain jo shauraseni ka svaroop batalaaya gaya hai, usi se spasht ho jaata hai ki jo svaroop yahaaain saamaanya praakrut ka batalaaya gaya hai, vah shauraseni ka hi kaalaanusaar viksit roop hai. udaaharanaarth shauraseni mein madhyavarti t aur th ke sthaan kramash: d aur dh hote hain, vahaaain praakrut mein d ka lop aur th ka h hota hai. "bh" dhaatu ka shauraseni mein "bho" hi rahata hai, ki kintu praakrut mein vahaaain "ho" aadesh kaha gaya hai. shauraseni mein napunsak bahuvachan ke roop mein vahaaain ni hota hai, jaise jalaani, vaanani, vahaaain praakrut ke keval i rahata hai, jaise jalaain, vanaain shauraseni mein dola, dand tatha dasan ka aadi d prakruti roop rahata hai, jabki praakrut mein vah d ho jaata hai, jaise dola, dand va dasan ityaadi.
praakrutaprakaash ke pashchaat praakrut tatha usaki praadeshik bhaashaaon ka sarvaangapoorn niroopan karanevaala, praakrut vyaakaran hemachandr dvaara 12veen shati E. mein likha gaya. iske chaar parichhed hain, jinmein se lagbhag saadhe teen parichhedon mein praakrut ka suvyavasthit vivran diya gaya hai aur shesh lagbhag 200 sootron mein kramash: shauraseni, maagadhi, paishaachi, choolika paishaachi aur apabhransh bhaashaaon ke vishesh lakshan batalaae hain. in bhaashaaon mein se pratham teen ka svaroop to adhik vistrut roop me vahi hai jo oopar batalaaya ja chuka hai. choolika paishaachi ke lakshan yahaaain chaar sootron mein ye batalaae gaye hain ki usamein teesare aur chauthe varno ke sthaan par pratham aur dviteeya ka aadesh hota hai, r ka l vikalp se hota hai, kuchh aachaaryo ke mat se aadivrn ki dhvani mein parivartan naheen hota, shesh baatein paishaachi ke samaan jaanani chaahiye.

Bhabhi Ko Patni Samjh Kar Galti Se Chudai-1
Friends galti se insan kia kia kar sakti hai. Yeh kahani padne ki bad app samaj payega. Patni samajh ke apni bhabhi ko mast aur jabardast choda. Baat tab ki hai jab mai ek nayi choot ki talash mai laga tha. par meri talaash poori nahi ho rahi thi. Bahut pareshaan sa ho gaya tha. kyunki bina chudai ke itna waqt katana mere jaise logo ke liye aasan nahi tha. Humko toh roz choot mile. toh hum roz chudai ke maaze lene ko taaiyar rehate hai. Par iss baar kismet saath nahi de rahi thi. Essi koi ladki nahi mil rahi thi jo apni marzi se chudai karvane ke liye taiyaar ho. Bhabhi Ko Patni Samjh Kar Galti Se Chudai.
Mere ghar ke pass ek pati patni aur old lady jo uss aadmi ki maa thi, rehate the. Chunki wo mujhse thode bade the. toh mai unko bhaiya bhabhi kehta tha. Aab har baar har aurat ko aap ek hi nazar se toh nahi dekh sakte. aur mere unn logo se kaafi close relation ho gaye the. toh maine kabhi unko galat nazar se nahi dekha tha.
Waise bhi mera ek usool hai ki mai aurat ko poori azaadi deta hu ki. wo apne aap kahe ki who mere saath chudai karna chahati hai ya nahi.
Yehi kahani yaha bhi thi.
Par kehate hai na, jab kisi se milna hota hai toh mil he jate hai aur raaste apne aap nikal aate hai. Essa he kuch mere saath yaha bhi hua.
Iss baat ki maine kabhi kalpana bhi nahi ki thi ki mere hum bister hone wali agli aurat mere pass mai rehane wali yehi bhabhi hogi. Par waqt ne essa mod liya aur hum ek he bister pe nange ek doosre ki baaho mai the. Kahani ne mod kaise liya bus wahi suna-ne layak hai.
Ek din bhaiya ne mujhko kissi kaam se ghar aane ko kaha. Mai subha 11 baje ke kareeb unke ghar pahuch gaya. Ghar mai ghuste he unki maa mujhe mil gayi.
Maie unse bhaiya ke bare mai poocha toh who boli – who kahi bahar gaye hai aur aane wale hai aur yeh kaha kar unhone mujhko baithne ke liye kaha.
Mai baith kar bhaiya ke aane ka intezzar karne laga aur amma mere liye paani lene rasoi mai chali gayi. Bhabhi bhi ghar mai nahi dikh rahi thi. Amma aayi aur mujhko paani dekar boli ki unko pass ke mandir mai puja ke liye jaana hai. Itna kaha kar who ghar ke andar gayi aur bhabhi ko awaaz laga kar apne jaane ki baat kaha de. Iska matlab bhabhi ghar mai he thi. “Galti Se Chudai”
Woh chali gayi aur mai bhaiya ke aane ka intezzar karne laga. Meri kismat mai kuch badalna tha aur mai us-se anjaan waha kisi ka intezzar kar raha tha.
Mai wahi baitha tha, meri nazar andar wale kamre mai padi jaha bhabhi towel lapete hue thi, naha kar aayi thi. Unko yeh bilkul pata nahi tha ki mai wahi baitha tha.
Amma ke jaane ke baad unko laga ki who ghar mai akeli hai toh woh bathroom se sirf towel lappet kar room mai aa gayi thi aur room ka darwaza halka sa khula tha jaha se andar ka thoda sa bhaag aur bed dikh raha tha.
Unke towel ne unko poora dhaka hua tha par dosto, aap khud he soch kar dekho ki ek jawan 30 saal ke as-pass ekdum zero size toh nahi kahunga par kasa hua jism aapke samne ek towel mai naha kar nikale, paani ki bunde uske jism par chamak rahi ho toh kya aap apne hathiyaar pe kaboo mai rakh payenge, essa he kuch mere saath hua.
Uss aurat ko maine uss nazar se kabhi dekha toh nahi tha par aaj usko iss halat mai dekh kar mere andar ki vasna bhadakne lagi thi. Jism bahut gora nahi toh sawala bhi nahi tha. Ubhar apne charam par the, towel ke niche se jhankti chikni taange. “Galti Se Chudai”
Dosto, ek baat kehana chahunga, shayad mai yaha woh bata na saku jaisa maine feel kiya, toh aap logo ki kalpana ka sahara lete hue uss waqt ko dekhna hoga aur mai pakke se yeh kaha sakta hu ki agar aapne yeh kalpana sahi se kar li ki aap bhi kisi ke ghar baithe hai aur halke se khule darwaze se aapki nazar essi aurat par padti hai jo abhi abhi naha kar apne jism par sirf ek towel lapete hue aapki upasthiti se anjaan apne he taaiyari mai lagi hai aur aap usko dekh rahe hai toh meri shart hai ki aap bina apne lund ko masle nahi raha payenge.
Toh jaisa mai bata raha tha ki bhabhi uss kamre mai aayi aur taaiyar hone lagi. Maine dekha ki woh apne bra aur penty apne haatho mai laekar aayi thi jinko unhone bed par daal diya. Woh apne baal jhatak kar sukha rahi thi aur mai unko bina palak jhapkaye dekh raha tha. “Galti Se Chudai”
Aab kamayat aane wali thi aur bhabhi ne apna towel hata diya aur apne khule baal fan ke niche sukhane lagi.
Aaj tak aurato ko maine nanga kiya tha, par aaj meri aankho ke samne jaise kahani ulti chal rahi thi. Pehali nazar mai he mujhko aurat nangi dik rahi thi.
Unke jism ka aakar kuch ulta S jaisa tha. Jitna unke boobs aage nikale the utna he hipps piche the. Choot ka hissa thoda ubhra hua tha. Vaise choot dikh toh nahi rahi thi par andaza lagaya ja sakta tha ki wo swarag ka dwaar kaha hoga.
Bhabhi ki pith meri taraf ho gayi thi, jaha se mai unke aage ka part toh nahi dekh pa raha tha par nangi pith aur gand ki darar saaf dikh rahi thi. Bhabhi ne apni bra uthai aur palak jhapakte he pehan li. Phir unhone apni penty pehani aur phir kurta pehan kar khadi ho gayi. Unka pyjama abhi wahi pada tha. “Galti Se Chudai”
Mai soch raha tha ki mere saath kya ho raha hai jo kapde mujhe utarne hai, wo toh ye pehane ja rahi hai. Aaj yeh ulti ganga kaha se baha rahi hai. Tabhi bhabhi ne apna pyjama uthaya aur pehan-ne lagi. Pyjame ko apne paer mai dalne ke liye bhabhi ne apna paer palang par rakha aur thoda niche jhuk kar pyjama paer mai dalne lagi. Tabhi unki nazar mujh par pad gayi jo unko lagatar dekhe ja raha tha.
Bhabhi ne jaldi se pyjama chod kar door band kar diya par aab tak teer Kaman se nikal chukka tha. Meri pent tambu ban chuki thi aur mere samne usko shant karne ke alava koi rasta nahi tha. Maine uth kar maine gate ko band kiya aur bhabhi ke darwaje ko halka sa dhakka diya toh darwaza poora khul gaya. Bhabhi ne use andar se band nahi kiya tha.
Maine dekha ki bhabhi ka pyjama abhi bhi wahi pada hai aur bhabhi wall ke sahare ankhe band kar ke khadi thi, unki saanse bahut tezi se chal rahi thi aur itni he fast ki unke muume bi upar niche ho rahe the. Mai bhabhi ke pass pahucha aur unka haath pakad liya. Bhabhi ne ek dum apni aankhe kholi aur mujhko apne samne dekh ke wo sharma gayi. Na to unke mukh se na he mere muh se awaaz nikal rahi thi. Wo apni aankhe niche karke khadi thi aur mai unko dekhe ja raha tha. “Galti Se Chudai”
Tabhi unko dhyaan aaya ki abhi tak wo nangi he hai aur unhone pyjama nahi pehana hua hai toh wo tezi se mujhse haath chuda ke pyjama lene bhagne lagi par wo apna haath mere haath se nahi chuda paayi aur maine unko apni taraf khich liya. Wo iske liye taiyaar nahi thi to wo sidhe mere upar aa gayi. Maine unko ekdum se apni baaho mai le liya. Mai unki pith sehlane laga aur wo mujhse dour jaane ki koshish karne lagi.
Maine bhabhi ko kas ke apne se chipka rakha tha aur bhabhi ko bhi yeh baat samajh aa gayi thi toh unhone apne dono haath hum dono ke bich rakh liya taaki mumme mere se choo na paye.
Unki iss intelligence par mujhko gussa aur pyaar dono aa raha tha. Wo mujhe dour jaane ke liye jor laga rahi par meri taakat ke samne aur unki halat ke karan wo nikal nahi pa rahi thi. Mere haath unki pith aur nitumbo ko sehla rahe the. “Galti Se Chudai”
Phir maine bhabhi ko deewar ke sahare laga diya taaki wo mujhse dour na jaaye aur ek haath unke nitumbo pe rakh diya aur usko dabane laga aur doosra haath se unki chin ko upar karke unko bola – maine aaj tak aapko iss nazar se kabhi bhi nahi dekha tha par aaj jo roop maine aapka dekha hai uske baad main khud ko rok nahi paunga.
Wo aankhe band karke meri baat sun rahi thi aur dour jaane ki koshish lagatar kar rahi thi.
Aab unhone kaha – yeh galat hai, mai essa kuch nahi karna chahati.
Par unke bolne mai ek kampan tha aur mai apne experience se itna toh samajh pa raha tha ki yeh sirf isliye nahi hai kyunki bhabhi ne kabhi apne ko kissi gair aadmi ki baaho mai socha nahi tha aur aaj ki iss achanak hui baat se wo bhi meri taraf sambhal nahi paayi thi par unko utna boora bhi nahi lag raha tha.
Vaise bhi aab unko apne se dour bhi nahi kar sakta tha so maine unke hilate hue hotho par apne hoth rakh diye aur unko chusne laga. Mera ek haath unki pith sehala raha tha aur doosra unke sir ko pakad ke apni taraf dhakel raha tha. Piche diwaar hone ke karan bhabhi mujhse dour nahi ho pa rahi thi. Mai unke hotho ko chusne maai laga pada tha. “Galti Se Chudai”

jo ki same topic per hote Hain, aise mein YouTube isko repeated content bolata hai, yani ek hi content ko ek hi topic ko bar bar aap upload kiye ja rahe Ho, aur aise mein aap ek good creator nahin manae jaate ho, aur yah award sirf good creator yaani acche creator ko hi Diya jata hai. to agar aapke channel per repeated content hai, to aap ke channel ko is award se reject Kiya ja sakta hai.
Reason (2)Aapke channel ko is vajah se bhi award ke liye reject Kiya ja sakta hai, agar aapke channel per misleading content upload kiya jata hai, yaani aapane Jo apni video ke thumbnail per show kiya hai, vah aapki video mein hai hi nahin.
aise mein jo users us video ke thumbnail Ko dekhkar click kiya tha vah information usko video mein Mila hi nahin. to aise mein aap users ko mislead kar rahe ho. aur aise creators ko yah award nahin diya jata. agar aap apne channel par missleading content upload karte ho, to aapko award ke liye reject milega.
Reason (3)Is vajah se bhi aapke channel ko is award ke liye reject Kiya jata hai, agar aap apni video ke description mein kafi jyada keywords ka use karte hain, bahut jyada keyword dalte Hain to aise mein YouTube isko spam manta hai.
aise mein bhale hi aapko jyada views mil jaaye lekin aapko yah award nahin milega, aapko apni video ke description mein Sirf kuchh hi Keywords ka use Karna hai, jo aapki video se related hai 5 6 7 keyword ka hi use Karna hai.
lekin agar aap log bahut jyada ki keywords dalte Ho to aise mein vah spam mana jata hai aur aise creator ko award nahin diya jata, to aapka channel reject Kiya jaega.
How to Get Silver Play Button After Reject YouTube?
Ab dost ham baat karte hain agar YouTube channel aapka reject ho chuka hai, silver play button ke liye, to app Kaise dobara Se apna silver play button pa sakte hain. to sabse pahle doston aapko yah galtiyan sudharna Hoga.
jo maine aapko upar bataya hai, aapke channel per misleading content Ko hatana hoga, apni video ke description mein se vah sabhi spam keywords Ko hatana hoga, aur agar aap ke channel per repeated content hai, to aapko repeated content ko delete karna hoga.
agar aap log silver play button chahte ho to yah sabhi galtiyan aapko sudharna hogam tabhi jakar aapko silver play button mil payega. Apne description ko edit aur repeated content ko aapko remove karna hoga, kuchh videos, aur misleading thumbnail, title, tags, unko bhi sudhar Na hoga.
tab jakar aapko aapka silver play button milega. aur jab aapka channel ek bar reject ho jata hai, to aap usko 90 days ke bad hi, dobara youtube se appeal kar sakte hai, ke aapko silver play button chahiye. tabhi vah aapke channel ko check karenge 90 days se pehle nahi karenge.

Aur iss wajah se wo log 25 saal ki umra mai 40 saal ke dikhai dene lagte hai. Vaise to baal jhadna aajkal behad aam baat hai. Kehte hai yadi din mai karib 100 baal jhadte hai.

Vartaman samay mai yeh samasya yuwao mai bahut teji se badh rahi hai. Aajkal har dusra vyakti baal jhadne ki samasya se pareshan hai. Lekin yadi aap apne aahar mai Vitamin B ki matra badha denge to kaafi had tak aapko iss samasya se nijat mil jayegi.

Hair Loss: Baalo Ko Girne Se Rokne Ke Upay
Baalo ka asamy jhadna ya girne se rokne ke liye yeh jaruri hai ki pehle aap pata kare ki kin karno se aapke baal adhik jhad rahe hai. Jab tak vastavik karan ka upchar naa kiya jaye Hair loss rokna kathin karya hai. Hair loss hone ke mool karan ka upchar karne ke sath niche diye gaye anya upya ka upyog kar aap baalo ke girne mai viraam laga sakte hai.
Santulit Aahar Le
Baalo ki growth ke liye high protein diet lena behad jaruri hai. Prachur matra mai protein lene ke liye subah naste mai ankurit anaj, mung, dudh aur soyabin lena chahiye. Bhojan mai dal ko patla banane ki jagah dal gadhi bana kar khana chahiye.
Snacks mai fast food ki jagah par bhune hue mungfali ya chana lena chahiye. Roti banane ke liye gehu ke aate mai 1⁄4 hissa soyabin ka aata milakar roti banana chahiye.

Ki vishesh aavyashakta hoti hai. Isliye aahar mai aese anna ka samawesh hona jaruri hai. Jinme inn sabhi aahar padharto ki prachur matra ho.

Pregnancy ke douran, breast feeding karte samay aur uske 3 months baad tak iron, Calcium, Protein prachur matra mai lena chahiye. Typhoid ke sankraman ke baad bhi adhik hair loss hota hai, isme bhi santulit aahar aur poshan jaruri hai.

Apne baalo mai Suddha Aloe Vera Gel se hafte mai do baar massage bhi kar sakte hai. Massage karne ke baad do ghante tak ise aese hi rehne de aur gun gune pani se baalo ko saaf kar de.
Aisa karne se baalo ki growth badhti hai aur baal majbut hote hai.
Tel Ki Malish
Agar aap dry baalo mai shampoo karte hai to isse bhi aapke baal jhadne lagte hai. Isliye shampoo karne se pehle baalo mai halke garm olive oil ya coconut oil se massage kare. Baalo ki jado mai tel ki acche se massage rat ko sone se pehle hi kar lena chahiye. Isse na keval baalo ki jade majbut hoti hai. Balki baal bhi shine karte hai.
Roj Vyayam Kare
Agar hamara sharir swasth ho to hame kisi bhi tarah ki pareshani nahi hoti hai. Isliye baal jhadna rokne ke liye niyamit vyayam kare. Vyayam karne se sharir mai blood circulation thik se hota hai, aur aap nirogi rehte hai.

'' Uttar pradesh ka baayein haath ka ballebaaj raina Virendra Sehwag ki aguaai waali shesh Bhaarat team ka hissa hai jise chhah se 10 February tak Wankhede stadium mein Ranji champion Mumbai se bhidna hai. Shesh Bhaarat ke khilaadiyon ne match se pehle aaj dopahar stadium mein abhyaas kiya lekin is dauraan kaptaan Sehwag, Harbhajan Singh, murali vijay aur manoj tivaari maujood naheen the. Isliye mujhe pata hai ki agar main apne khel par kadi mehnat karta hoon to nishchit taur par kam se kam 50 se 60 test match khel paaoonga. '' Unhonne kaha, ''Pehle pehle hi chhathe ya saatavein number par ballebaaji karte hue 150 ke kareeb (van-de) match khel chuka hoon isliye mujhe pata hai ki ballebaaji karte hue mujh par kaisa dabaav hota hai lekin fir bhi mere paas kaafi anubhav hai. Isliye agar is baar mujhe mauka milta hai to main apni jagah pakki karne ki koshish karoonga. '' Raina ne satr ki shurooaat mein New Zealand ke khilaaf do test khele the. Nai Delhi praakrutik gas ke ghareloo utpaadan ki keematon ke sambandh mein Reliance industries limited ke pramukh mukesh Ambani ke khilaaf maamala darj karne ki kaarravaai ko Reliance ne Delhi High Court mein chunauti di hai. Delhi ki tatkaaleen Kejriwal sarkaar ke nirdesh par par Delhi bhrashtaachaar nirodhak shaakha ki or se yeh FIR darj karaai gayi thi. Reliance ne yaachika daayar kar gas moolya vruddhi maamale ko lekar darj praathamiki ko radd karne ki maang ki hai. Justice Manmohan ki khandapeeth ne yaachika par sunavaai ke liye 20 May ki taareekh tay ki hai. Shukravaar ko is yaachika par sunavaai naheen ho pai, kyonki swayam Reliance ki or se yaachika ko kuchh samay ke liye taalane ka aagrah adaalat ke samaksh kiya gaya. Adaalat mein Reliance industries limited ne kaha hai ki Kejriwal sarkaar ne unke khilaaf yeh mukadama poori tarah se raajaneeti se prerit hokar darj karaaya hai, jisse ki vah iska raajaneetik faayda chunaav ke dauraan utha sakein. Unke khilaaf galat tathyon ke aadhaar par praathamiki darj ki gayi hai. Vidhaanasabha chunaav prachaar ke samay aam aadmi party ne jo jhoothe aarop lagaae the, unheen ke aadhaar par praathamiki darj karva di. Itna hi naheen samvidhaan ke anusaar praakrutik gas ke moolyon ka maamala raajya sarkaar ke antargat naheen aata hai, balki kendra sarkaar ke adheen hai. Aise mein raajya sarkaar ki koi bhi agency aise maamalon ki jaach naheen kar sakti hai. Delhi ke mukhyamantri rahate hue Kejriwal ne ainti-corruption athauriteej ko yeh FIR darj karna ka nirdesh diya tha. Yeh FIR poorv cabinet sachiv TSR subramaniyn sahit kai jaaneemaani shakhsiyton ki shikaayat ke aadhaar par karaai gayi thi. Shikaayat mein kaha gaya tha ki petrolium mantri veerappa moili, poorv mantri murali devada aur anya ne mukesh Ambani ke saath milkar unke hit mein praakrutik gas ke daam badhaae. Moili aur Ambani ne in aaropon ko poori tarah se khaarij kiya hai.

Jaise ki hum sabhi jante hi hai, ki ladkiyo se unki tareef karte raho bus usse wo khush hai chahe jhuth pe jhuth bolte raho. Use baar baar realize karwate raho ki aap uski kitni care karte Ho. Bhale hi aap ne subhah se kuch na khaya ho but use puchte raho khana khaya. Unhe majakiya ladke pasand hote hai, majak se unka time paas karte raho. Lakiyon ko emotional or boring baatein bilkul pasand nahi aati. Jaha aap ne emotional or boring baatein karna shuru ki to ladki bhi hath se nikalna shuru ho jayegi. Aaye kuch or baatein jaante hai jo ladkiyo ko hashi majak ke ilawa bhi pasand hai or achi lagti hai.
Ladkiyon Ko kya Pasand Ata Hai
Unki Tareef
Ladkiyo ki jum ke tareef kare ye hi unhe sabse jyada acha lagta hai. Unke kapdo ki tareef kare or itni jyada bhi na kare ki unhe lage aap unka majak uda rahe ho. Respect har ladki ke liye sabse important cheez hoti hai. Aap unhe agar respect denge to unhe aapke sath ya friend banne me koi pareshani nahi hogi.
Hygienic (Saaf Sutre)
Ladkiyo Ko saaf sutri cheez pasand hoti hai, chahe unhe khud safai karna pasand na ho par cheez unko saf sutri chahiye. Par agar hum ladkiyo ki pasand unki pasand ki ladko me dekhte hai to har ladki ki apni apni pasand hoti hai. Jaise safai ka matlab yahan ye nahi hai ki ladki ko daddi ya muche (beard or moustache) wale ladke pasand nahi hai. Ho sakta hai ki kuch ko clean shave wale ladke pasand ho or kisi ko halki ya ghani daddi wale.
Well mannered
Ladkiyo ko ye bilkul bhi pasand nahi hai ki koi unke ageh piche gujarte hue comment pass kare ya unhe goorte rahe. Agar aap aise ladko ki sangat me jo ati jati har ladki ko comment pass karte hai, to aapka har ladki par bad impression padega, chahe aapne comment kiya ho ya na kiya ho.
Ghumna Firna
Ladkiyo ko ghumne ka bahut shok hota hai, or jab koi paise wala boyfriend ho to fir to unki kismat hi khul jati hai. Boyfriend ka paisa udana sari ladkiyo ka kaam nahi hota, par han unhe ghoomna sach much bahut pasand hota hai.
Shopping Karna
Ghumne Ke ilawa ladkiyo ko shopping karne ka bahut shok hota hai. Tv par new cheeze dekh ke sidha shopping ke liye chal padti hai. Cheeze sasti bhi hogi fir rate kam karwana unhe bahut pasand hai. Agar aap boyfriend hone naate unhe menhgi cheeze bhi dilate ho to unhe wo bhi pasand hota hai.
Masti Majak
Girls ko chipku or emotional type ke ladke bilkul bhi pasand nahi ate. Unko wohi ladke ache lagte hai jo unka time-pass kare or unse masti majak se kare. Lekin agar majak jyada hadd tak ho jaye to unhe bura lagne me derr nahi lagti or mooh fula leti hai. Isiliye har cheez ek hadd tak hi kare, nahi to aapko bahut sehna padh sakta hai.
Special Feel Hona
Jab Ladkiyan roti hai ya naraz hoti to unko koi manaye wo unko acha lagta hai. Wo apne aapko safe feel karti hai, jab aapko unko unki kamar se pakad kar najdik late hai or jab ye kahenge ki “everything is gonna be all right” tab to wo apki deewani ho jayegi. Ladkiyo ko special feel hona behad pasand hai agar aap unke maathe(forhead) par kiss kare wo bhi apne sabhi friends ke samne to unko ye ehsaas hota ki aap unki sach much me kitni care karte hai.
Pampered Feel Hona
Ladkiyo ko pasand hai lad pyaar, aap agar unse gusse me ye tej aawaz me baat karenge to wo aapko bilkul bhi pasand nahi karegi. Agar aap unki har choti se lekar badi baat ka khayal rakhenge to unhe aapko friend se boyfriend bnane me derr nahi lagegi.

Cricket » Saturday, February 9, 2013
Mumbai: Pichhle dedh saal se test cricket mein bhaarateeya team ke pramukh khilaadiyon ka lagaataar kharaab form chinta ka sabab bana huaa hai, lihaaja Australia ke khilaaf aagaami series ke liye ravivaar ko team chunana chayanakartaaon ke liye aasaan kaam naheen hoga. Pichhli teen shrunkhalaaen haarne ke baad samiti ke liye chunauti vijayi team sanyojan chunane ki hai. Aise mein Harbhajan Singh, suresh raina aur shreesant jaise khilaadiyon ki test team mein vaapasi par vichaar kiya ja sakta hai. England aur Australia se unki sarjameen par haarne vaale Bhaarat ne vest Indies aur New Zealand jaisi kamjor teemon par jeet darj ki. England ke khilaaf haalaanki apni sarjameen par 1-2 se mili haar ke baad senior khilaadiyon ke form ko lekar chinta paida ho gayi hai. Inmein Virendra Sehwag aur Gautam gambhir shaamil hain. Vaise prabhaavi vikalp ke abhaav mein chayanakarta donon ko barkaraar rakh sakte hain. Khaaskar chennai mein 22 February se hone vaale pehle test ke liye. Sehwag ka test record behatareen raha hai, jinhonne England ke khilaaf pehle test mein shatak bhi banaaya tha. Vaheen gambhir ka pichhli 16 paariyon mein sarvochch test score 93 raha hai, jo 25 maheene pehle unhonne dakshin Africa ke khilaaf banaaya tha. Donon milkar Bhaarat ko achhi shuruaat naheen day sake hain. England ke khilaaf reserve salaami ballebaaj murali vijay ko ek bhi match khelne ka mauka naheen mila. Unhonne Mumbai ke khilaaf Irani cup match mein shesh Bhaarat ke liye shatak jamaakar form jaahir kar diya. Chayanakartaaon ko yadi koi aur vikalp chaahiye to anubhavi vaseem jaafar hain, jo apne career mein paanch test shatak laga chuke hain. Unhonne aakhiri test 2008 mein dakshin Africa ke khilaaf khela tha. Ghareloo cricket mein bhi unhonne kaafi run banaae hain. Irani cup mein shesh Bhaarat ke khilaaf Mumbai ke liye unhonne 80 run ki paari kheli. Mumbai ke liye khel rahe sachin Tendulkar ka 140 run banaakar form mein lautana bhi chayanakartaaon ke liye raahat ka sabab raha hoga. Cheteshvar pujaara aur viraat Kohli ka chayan tay hai. Madhyakram ke daavedaaron mein raina, ajinkya rahaane, rohit sharma, manoj tivaari aur Yuvraj Singh bhi hain. New Zealand ke khilaaf do test maichon ki shrunkhala mein kharaab pradarshan ke baad raina ko baahar kar diya gaya. Unhonne bhi Irani cup mein shesh Bhaarat ke liye shatak jadkar apna daava majaboot kiya hai. Rahaane ne bhi Mumbai ke khilaaf 83 run banaae, lekin baaki teen kuchh naheen kar sake. Rohit ne apna wicket gair-jimmedaaraana dhang se ganva diya. Yuvraj ka to team mein chayan hi naheen huaa. England ke khilaaf Nagpur mein aakhiri test ke liye team se unhein baahar karke Ravindra jadeja ko shaamil kiya gaya tha.

Bhaarateey vaayusena Pakistan aur chin se satee seema par ab tak ka sabase bada yuddhaabhyaas karane ja rahee hai. gagan shakti 2018 naam ka yuddhaabhyaas 8 se 22 april ke beech hogee. isake lie vaayusena pramukh aadesh jaaree karenge jisake 48 ghante ke andar apne yuddhak saajosaamaan ke saath vaayusena vor mod mein aa jaegee. is abhyaas ke lie vaayusena apane hathiyaaron aur ladaakoo vimaanon ko seema par le jaane kee taiyaaree kar rahee hai. is yuddhaabhyaas mein vaayusena ke lagabhag 1100 vimaan aur heleekoptar hissa lenge. yah eksarasaij Pakistan se satee pashchimee seema aur chin se satee uttaree seema par kee jaegee. is abhyaas mein bhaarat mein bana halka ladaakoo vimaan tejas bhee hissa lega. is dauraan aakraamak aur bachaav sambandhee mishanon ko anjaam dega. is eksarasaij mein nevee ka mig 29 ladaakoo vimaan bhee hissa lega. is baare mein aupachaarikataon ko poora karate hue padosee desh Pakistan ko is baare mein jaanakaaree de dee gaee hai.
yah yuddhaabhyaas kitane bade star par kiya jaega isaka andaaja isee baat se lagaaya ja sakata hai ki eksarasaij ke lie 300 adhikaaree aur kareeb 15,000 vaayu sainik seema par pahunchane vaale hain. vaayusena ke is abhyaas mein indiyan aarmee aur nevee bhee shaamil honge.is abhyaas ke dauraan bhaarat apanee raksha aur aakraamak kshamataon ka pradarshan karega. vaayusena registaan aur kaee oonche ilaakon mein khaas mishan aur opareshan karane ka abhyaas karegee. is dauraan ladaakoo vimaan gujaraat ke bhuj se udaan bharakar asam mein bamabaaree karenge jabaki asam se udane vaale phaitar jet raajasthaan mein maujood lakshyon ko nishaana banaenge. is dauraan ghaatee mein sena kee tukadiyaan kee halachal bhee hogee.
ek varishth adhikaaree ne is baare mein jaanakaaree dete hue kaha, yah abhyaas 20 hajaar pheet kee oonchaee, garm registaanee ilaakon aur samudree ilaakon mein kiya jaega. is dauraan ham vaayusena kee phaayaring renj ka bhee istemaal karenge. vaayusena abhyaas ke dauraan vimaanon aur heleekoptaron kee alag-alag mahatvoorn ilaakon mein lainding bhee karavaegee.
eksarasaij mein shaamil hone vaale 1100 vimaan aur heleekoptar din mein 3 se 4 baar mishan ko anjaam dene ke lie udaan bharenge. vimaanon kee udaan ke dauraan takaneekee khaamiyon ke samaadhaan ke lie hindustaan aironotiks limited aur bhaarat ilektroniks limited ke takaneekee jaanakaar sena ke bes par maujood rahenge. raksha jagat se jude logon ke alaava is eksarasaij mein relave, naagarik uddayan aur masheenaree se jude kaee karmachaaree maujood honge.

RFID praudyogiki ke kai upayogon mein se ek hai unka pustakaalayon mein prayog. is praudyogiki ne dheere-dheere pustakaalaya ki cheejon par (kitaabein, CD, DVD, aadi) paaramparik baarakod ki jagah lena shuroo kar diya hai. RFID taig mein pehchaan sambandhit jaankaari ho sakti hai jaise ek pustak ka sheershak ya saamagri prakaar, jiske tahat ek alag daataabes ki or ishaara karne ki aavashyakta naheen hogi (lekin yeh uttar America mein durlabh hai). yeh jaankaari ek RFID reedar dvaara padhi jaati hai, jo maanak baarakod reedar ko jo saamaanyat: ek pustakaalaya ki sanchalan mej par paaya jaata hai, pratisthaapit karta hai. pustakaalaya saamagri par paaya jaane wala RFID taig aamtaur par uttar America mein 50 mm X 50 mm aur Europe mein 50 mm x 75 mm ke naap ka hota hai. ise baarakod ki jagah ya usamein shaamil kiya ja sakta hai, jo staaf ko soochi prabandhan ka ek alag tareeka aur lene vaalon ko swayam seva pradaan karega. yeh ek suraksha upakaran ke roop mein bhi kaarya kar sakte hain aur paramparaagat vidyut chumbakeeya patti[28] ki jagah le sakte hain aur na keval kitaabein, balki sadasyata card mein bhi ek RFID taig lagaaya ja sakta hai.

After four consequent electoral defeats, Parakala withdrew from the electoral arena. He concentrated on public discourse through the current affairs programmes on television and his profession as a policy analyst. But in 2008 some like minded people approached Parakala with an intention to start a new alternative political platform. Popular matinee idol Chiramjivi was to be the face of the party. Parakala lent his support to the idea and worked to establish the party. He was one of the signatories to the application for the registration of the Political Party 'Prajarajyam' and one of its founding General Secretaries and spokespersons. But the experimented turned out to be another disappointment for Parakala. He found that there was no clear agenda and party tickets were given in exchange of money. Several local leaders openly hurled accusations at the party leadership. Parakala held a press conference at the party headquarters and launched a scathing attack on the party leadership for betraying the ideals for which the new platform was to stand for. Terming the party as Poisonous Ivy (Vishavruksham), he announced his resignation. That address to the press was telecast live and thousands viewed it across the state. That spelt the doom for the party. A party that was hoping to have an impressive performance ended up with securing just 18 seats with the charismatic Chiramjivi himself losing one of the two seats he contested from his native place. Many people still question the moral and ethical basis of Parakala holding a press conference at the party headquarters to criticise the party and its leadership. Opinion is still bitterly divided on this. The Prajarajyam seems to have put an end to the party and electoral political career of Parakala.
After the Iranian Revolution, Pakravan was among the first of the Shah's officials to be executed. He was not allowed to have access to a lawyer and the charges filed against him were vague. Given the fact that he was retired at the time of the revolution, his execution seemed all the more unjust. Pakravan was a key player in convincing the Shah to commute the death sentence on Khomeini in 1963 and instead sending him to exile. Khomeini was first sent to Turkey, and then to Iraq, where he stayed until his expulsion and relocation to France in 1978.

Maa Or Bacche Ke Liye Best Hai Breastfeeding, maa ka doodh bacche ke liye kyu accha hai?
Maa banane ki anumati nari ko jaha sukhad ehsas se bhar deti hai , wahi breastfeeding maa-sishu ko bhawnatmak rup se jodati bhi hai . Yah maa or bacche ko ek atut bandhan me bandhati hai . Breastfeeding bacche ke sharirik or mansik vikas me important role nibhne ke sath-sath maa ko bhi healthy banaye rakhti hai .
Breastfeeding se judi jaruri baatain –
- Janm ke 6 mahine tak sirf maa ka doodh hi pilaye .
- Bacche ke janm ke turant bad maa ka pila gadha doodh bacche ke liye bahut healthy hota hai . Isme moujud jaruri poshak tatv or antibodies bacche ko kai infection or bimariyo se surakshit rakhte hai .
- Jin baccho ko breastfeeding ki jati hai , ve jaldi bimar nahi padate .
- Maa ke doodh ki khasiyat iaka aasani se digest ho jana bhi hai yani issay sishu ko digestion related problem nahi hoti .
- Navjat sishu ko har do ghante me maa ka doodh pilaye yani rojana karib 8 se 12 bar .
- Sishu ko 20-20 minute tak dono taraf se doodh pilana chahiye , kyonki maa ke stan se pahle 5 minute tak sirf patla doodh aata hai , jissay bacche ko jaldi bhukh lag jati hai .
- Har bar doodh pilane se pahle apne stan ko kapade ya wet tissue paper se pochkar saaf kar le .
Sishu ke best hai breastfeeding .
- Maa ka doodh sishu ke liye best aahar hai . Isme moujud poshak tatv se sishu ka sampurn vikash hota hai .
- Breastfeeding bacche ko allergy ke sath-sath motapa , diabetes , canser jaisi bimariyo se bachata hai .
- Issay navjat ko kabj , diarrhea jaii pet sambandhi problem bhi nahi hoti .
- Bacche ka wajan santulit rahta hai .
- Breastfeeding se bacche ka IQ level bahut accha hota hai .
Maa ke liye bhi faidemand hai breastfeeding –
- Breastfeeding karane se mahilao me overial cancer or monopose ke pahle honewale breast cancer se bachaw hota hai .
- Issay mahilao me osteoporosis ki samasya bhi kam ho jati hai .
- Itna hi nahi , yah pregnancy ke douran badhe huye wajan ko kam karne me bhi madad karti hai .
- Breastfeeding se shrir me oxytocin namak hormone ka level badhata hai , jissay teji se garbhashay ki toning hoti hai or bleeding bhi kam hoti hai .

Aaj mai aapko is post ke through bataunga ki aap apne mobile phone ko hang hone se kaise bacha sakte hai.
Ham log jaante hai ki mobile ke liye sabse best operating system Android hai aur million logo ke paas android phones hai. Kuchh log sochte hai ki Android smartphone me hanging ka problem Android OS me errors ke karan hota hai.
Mai aapko kuchh tips bataunga jis se aapke smartphone me hanging ka problem solve ho jayega.

Phone Hanging Kya Hai ?
Jab mobile phone, user ke command ko respond dena band kar deta hai to ise hum phone hanging kahte hai. Isko phone crash bhi kaha jata hai.
Bahut baar aisa hota hai ki jab aap apne smartphone ke App ko open karte hai to wah jaldi open nahi hota hai. Phone automatically switch off or on hone lagta hai to isko aap kah sakte hai ki aapka phone hang ho raha hai.
Hanging ke condition me aapka phone ka speed bahut hi slow ho jaayega, battery adhik spend hoga aur aapka smartphone thik tarah se work nahi karega.
Mobile phone Ko Hang Hone Se Kaise Bachaye ?
Smartphone ke hang hone ke bahut se karan hai. Mobile phone ko hang se bachane ke liye mai aapko 16 tips bataunga jis se aapke mobile phone me hanging ka problem solve ho jayega.
1. Unwanted data (catched data) ko delete kare
Kya aap jaante hai ki sabhi website apne website ke page speed ko increase karne ke liye cache ka use karte hai ? Jab aap kisi website par visit karte hai to aapka phone automatically unwanted data ko store kar leta hai jisko ki cookies and caches kaha jaata hai.
Yah unwanted data aapke phone memory me store ho jayege jo ki Apps or other files ke liye available memory ko decrease kar deta hai. Apne smartphone se hamesha cache ko clear karte rahe.
Clear cache se aapka koi bhi application delete nahi hoga. Is se aapke phone par jitne bhi junk files hoge wah sabhi remove ho jayege or aapka storage increase karega or aapka device fast work karega.
Solution :- Yah problem ko aap setting me jakar asani se solve kar sakte hai.
Go to Setting >> Storage >> click on the Cache and click OK button to clear caches
2. Apps ko external memory (SD Card) me install kare
Sabhi users apne smartphone me bahut type ke App ko install karte hai. Jis time we App ko install karte hai, we is baat par dhyan nahi dete hai ki App kahan par install ho raha hai or iska effect phone ke performance par kya padega.
Adhik tar case me, by default sabhi Apps phone ke internal memory me hi install hota hai. Agar jyada Apps internal memory me install hoge to is se apps ko run karne ke liye space kam (less) pad jayegi aur iske karan internal memory par jyada load padega aur aapka device thik se work nahi karega.
Yadi aapka phone hang hota hai to Apps ko aap phone ke external memory (SD Card) me install kare. Jydatar external memory, internal memory ke comparison me adhik hota hai. Aur external memory ko aap apne jarurat ke hisab se increase bhi kar skate hai (2 GB card ke badle 8 GB card laga sakte hai).
Is tarah se aap apne phone ke internal memory par adhik load diye bina aasani se jyada Apps ko external memory me install kar sakte hai. Is se aapka phne hang nahi hoga.
Solution :- Iske liye aap default write disk ko set kar sakte hai.
Go to Setting >> Storage >> Default write disk >> select SD Card
Iski setting different mobile me different location par ho sakte hai. Yah setting karne ke baad ab application aapke mobile ke external memory cards me install hoga.
3. Installed apps ko internal se external memory me move kare
Aap kabhi bhi install App ko interanl se external memory me move kar sakte hai. Jaisa ki maine upar me batlaya, is se apps ko smoothly run karne ke liye jyada internal memory space milega. Jis se ki aapka phone hang nahi hoga.
Solution :- Install apps ko internal se external memory me move aap setting me jakar kar sakte hai.
Setting >> Apps >> click on App >> Click on Move to internal storage
Bahut se smarthpone me “Move to storage” ke place par “Move to SD Card” ho sakta hai.
4. Songs and other files ko external memory me save kare
Internal memory ka bahut hi jyada use karna, phone ke hang hone ka sabse bada karna hai. Apne Android Phone ke hanging problem ko solve karne ke liye aap songs, videos and other data ko external memory me save kare.
Aap iske solution ke liye apne files ko external memory me move kar sakte hai aur external memory ko default memory select kar sakte hai. Is se jitne bhi photo and video ko download karege we sabhi external me save hoge.
Camera ke through jitne bhi photo lege we sabhi external memory me hi save hoge aur internal memory par adhik load nahi padega.
External memory ko default memory banane ke liye second tips padhe.
5. Application Ko Proper Close Ya Exit Kare :
Jyadatar users application ko open karke proper rup se close ya exit nahi karte hai. We application ko close karne ke liye directly home button ka use karte hai. Is se wah application background me run karta rahta hai.
To aap imagine kar sakte hai ki aapke phone me kitne application install hai. Jab ye sabhi application run karte rahege to is se internal memory par adhik load padega aur mobile hang karne lagega. Isliye application se proper rup se exit ho.
6. Application ke attraction se bache
Aapke smartphone ke screen par live wallpapers, launcher and themes dekhne me bahut achchhe lagte hai aur sabhi users ko attract karte hai. Lekin yah bhi bahut hi CPU power ko consume karta hai aur is se bhi aapka phone hang ho sakta hai.
Isliye agar aapka phone hang ho raha hai to aap aise appliation ko avoid kare.
7. Unnecessary apps ko delete kar de
Bahut saare users ke Mobile me aise Apps hote hai jinka we use nahi karte hai prantu phir bhi we us app ko apne mobile me rakhte hai. Adhik Apps ke karan RAM par adhik load padta hai or yah faltu me memory ko waste karta hai. Isliye aap aise app ko uninstall karde jiska use aap nahi karte hai.
8. Mobile phone ko shut down kare
Everyday ek bar apne phone ko shut down karna bahut hi good idea hai kyoki is se aapke phone ka memory completely refresh ho jaata hai. Jab aap apne phone ko restart karege to iska memory faltu ke data se free ho jayega.
9. External memory me kuchh space rahne de
Maine aapko external memory me apps ko install karne ka importance pahle hi bataya lekin iska matlab yah nahi hai ki aap puri tarah se external memory ko full kar de.
Aapko external memory me bhi kuchh sapce rakhna padega taki Apps ko aasani se store kar sakte hai. Agar external memory puri tarah se full ho jata hai iske karna bhi aapka phone hang ho sakta hai.
10. App ko force stop kar de
Jyada users ke smartphone me sabse jyada in build app hote hai jinko ki aap uninstall nahi kar sakte hai. Agar aise App ka use adhiktar nahi karte hai to isko force stop kar de.
Agar phone me kuchh aise App hai jinka use aap kam karte hai aur unko uninstall bhi nahi karna chahte hai to is condition me us App ko force stop kar de taaki wah run nahi karta rahe.
Solution :-
Setting >> App >> select app >> Force stop
11. Unknown app ko disable and force stop kar de
Internet ke through kabhi-kabhi aapke smartphone par aise app install ho jaate hoge jinke baare me aap nahi jaante hoge. Is tarah ke app me uninstall karne ka option nahi hota hai.
Isko aap disable and force stop karke hi iske running ko stop kar sakte hai. Agar aapke bhi smartphone me is tarha ka app hai to usko disable and forcestop kar de.
Solution :-
Go to Setting >> App >> All >> select app >> Force stop and disable
12. App ke cache aur Data ko clear karte rahe
Jis App ko aap jyada use karte hai, usme cache and data store hote rahta hai. Iske karan internal memory par load padta. Agar yah cache aur data adhik store ho jaayenge to aapka phone hang karne lag sakta hai. Isliye cache aur data ko clear karte rahe.
Note :- Clear data karne ke baad agar aapke kisi app me account login hoga to wah remove ho jayega or aapko baad me phir se login karna padega. Agar aapne browser me bookmark ya page ko save karke rakha hoga to wah delete ho jayega.
Prantu clear data karne se mobile fast work karne lagta hai. Agar page ko save rakhna chahte hai to iska backup le le uske baad clear data kare.
Solution :-
Setting >> App >> click on app >> clear data & clear cache
13. Google play store se hi application install kare
Kisi bhi fake market se application ko install na kare. Is se aapke smartphone par bahut hi bad effect pad sakta hai. wah application aapke smartphone ko harm kar skata hai. Kyoki is tarah ke fake site par 90% application me virus hota hai. So, Google play store se hi app install kare.
14. Battery level 30% se upar rakhe
Smartphone me battary level ko hamesa 30% ke upar rakhe. Kyoki kuchh application ko jyada battery ki jarurat padti hai. Low battery rahne ke karan ho sakta hai ki application thik se work nahi kare aur hanging ka problem create ho.
Isliye hamesha pane smartphone ko charge rakhne ki koshish kare.
15. Kisi popular antivirus App Ko Install Kare
Apne smarthphone me ek achchha sa antivirus app ko install kare kyoki virus ke karan bhi aapka phone hang ho sakta hai. Antivirus se virus ko aasani se detect kiya ja sakta hai.
16. Factory reset options
Agar upar bataye hue tips ko follow karne ke baad bhi aapka phone hang karta hai to aapko factory reset karan padega. Factory reset karna sabse last option hai.
Factory reset ke baad sabhi unwanted files delete ho jaayega jo ki aapke browsers, website, Apps etc. se aate the. Factory reset karne ke liye yah post padhe : Android Phone Ka Factory Reset Kaise Kare ?

Aise hi questions ke answers hum apko dene ki koshish karenge.
Torrent ek free space ki tarha kaam karta hai. jo aam logo ko space deta hai ki wo apni bnayi koi bhi file share kar sake. Ek example se smjhate hai. jaise humne ek software bnaya or uska copyright hmare pass hai or ab hum chahte hai ki us software ka use sab log kare. Yani hum apne software ko dusro ke sath share karna chahte hai to hum apne software ki torrent file bna kar use upload kar skte hai.
Torrent ek jaal ki tarha kaam karta hai. example maine koi file download par lgai to us file ko main download to kar rha hu or sath hi sath upload bhi kar rha hu. Yani meri jo uploading ki speed hai usse koi or download kar rha hai. aise mein ek uploading or download ka ek network ban gya hai.
Ye question bahut bada hai or iska answer yes or No dono mein diya ja skta hai.
Asal mein ye illegal nahi hai. is par jo maximum content hai wo illegal hai. hota kya hai torrent hume aisa ek space deta hai jis par hum apni file share kar skte hai. example maan lijiye maine koi book likhi or uska copyright mere pass hai or main uska owner hu to main agar chahu to apni us book ko torrent pr upload kar ke use duniya ke sath share kar skta hu. prastut ank se ham ek nae stanbh ki shuruat kar rahe hain - vividha. is stanbh men pathkon ki jigyasa ke anurup unke labharth ham hamare aspas rahne vale logon ki najar, unke khan-pan, uthne-baithne, likhne-parhne adi ki mudraon aur unka anya logon par parne vale prabhavon ka vishleshan prastut karenge. shrinkhla ki pahli kari men logon ki najar aur uske bure prabhavon tatha unse bachav ke upayon ka vishleshan prastut hai.
najar agar pak ho, shubh ho, to kisi ki bigri jindgi sanvar de, par agar napak ho, buri ho, to kisi ki chain se gujar rahi jindgi men jaljla la de, uska jina dubhar kar de. ham jahan rahte hain, vahan hamare irda-gird kai aise log rahte hain, jinki buri najar kab ham par par jati hai, ham samajh bhi nahin pate aur hamara sukun bhara jivan dukhamay ho jata hai. kaise hota hai yah? kaise ham aisi najar ki pahchan karen? isse bachne ka upay kya ho? aie, janen...
najar athva upri havaen amtaur par sharirik v mansik rup se kamjor logon ko satati hain, saksham logon par inka prabhav bahut kam hota hai, ya fir nahin hota. islie najar athva upri havaon se grast kisi vyakti ko unse bachav ke upay batane ke purva uski sharirik sanrchna v kshamataon ke vishay men janna avashyak hai. isi tathya ke maddenajar, yahan sharir ki sanrchna ka vishad vivaran prastut hai.
û sthul sharir: sthul sharir se tatparya haddi aur majja se nirmit bahri sharir se hai, jismen pran nahin hai.
û sukshm sharir: sukshm sharir se tatparya sharir ki sukshmata se hai, jiske vishleshan se kisi vyakti ki sukshm sharirik kriyaon ki jankari prapt ki ja sakti hai.
û ati sukshm sharir: ati sukshm sharir vah hota hai, jismen apne atirikt bahri chijon ko dekhne ki kshamata hoti hai.
û manas sharir: jab manav sharir men mastishk apna karya karna praranbh kar de, to vah manas sharir kahlata hai.
û atmik sharir: jab manav sharir men atma ka pravesh ho jata hai aur atma tatva ko janne lagti hai, to aisa sharir atmik sharir kahlata hai.
û brahm sharir: brahmand men sthit tatvon se manav sharir ka ekikaran v prakritik tatvon se milan hone par brahm sharir kahlata hai.
û nirvan sharir: jab sharir se atma nikal jae aur vah atma svayan ko sharir manakar karya kare, to vah nirvan sharir kahlata hai.
jab najar manas sharir par parti hai, to parinam kuch aur hota hai aur jab najar atmik arthat brahm sharir ka chedan ya hras karti hai, to parinam usse bhinn hota hai. upri havaen v jivatmaen sabhi prakar ke shariron ko jakar lene men saksham hoti hain.
pratyek manushya ki dekhne ki apni kshamata hoti hai aur najar ki duri ki ek nishchit sima hai. ankhon se ek urja niklti hai, jiske prakash se ham dusron ko dekh pate hain. sanbhvtah aisa najar dosh prakashiya kirnon dvara hota hai.
ankhon ke rang bhi bhinna-bhinn hote hain. samanyatya hamen kali, nili, pili, bhuri, hari aur safed ankhen dekhne men ati hain. ankhon ke rangon ki bhinnata ke saman hi inki prakashiya kirnon ki kshamata v akarshan bhi bhinna-bhinn hota hai. kane vyakti ki najar men vishesh marak kshamata hoti hai aur yah teji se asar dalti hai. iske viprit bhainge vyakti ki najar asani se nahin lagti.

koi vyakti jab apne samne ke kisi vyakti athva uski kisi vastu ko ishryavash dekhe aur fir dekhta hi rah jae, to uski najar us vyakti athva uski vastu ko turat lag jati hai. aisi najar utarne hetu vishesh prayatn karna parta hai anyatha nuksan ki sanbhavna prabal ho jati hai.

kagaz 'prachin bharat ki lekhan samagriyon' men se ek hai, jo bahut hi mahattvapoorn sthan rakhata hai. kagaz ki upalabdhi ne gyan-vigyan aur snskriti ke vikas men bahut yogadan diya hai. prachin jagath ki kisi bhi any upalabdhi ko kagaz ke avishkar aur usase janit mudran-kala ke samakaksh nahin rakha ja sakata. in donon hi avishkaron ne adhunik manav ke bauddhik jivan par dirghakalin prabhav dala hai. kalpana kijie ki achanak hi kagaz ka utpadan ruk jata hai aur mudran kary band pad jata hai, tab hamare adhunik samaj ka kya hal hoga? halanki snchar ke any sadhan upalabdh hain, magar ve kagaz aur mudran ka sthan nahin le sakate hain.
